 FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN traversal t ON t.pointer=a.pointer WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build) ordered
 WHERE ordinal<>expected OR cycle_) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access order differs from native containment traversal' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(WITH region_counts AS (
 SELECT pointer,count(*) count_ FROM kb.pdf_record_region
 WHERE product_id=p_build AND revision_id=p_build GROUP BY pointer
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a LEFT JOIN region_counts counts ON counts.pointer=a.pointer
 WHERE a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND
 COALESCE(counts.count_,0)<>jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(a.native_json->'prov','[]'))) OR
 EXISTS(WITH page_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT pages.member_key,page_size.scalars_json AS dimensions
 FROM ops.pdf_record_document h JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership pages
 ON pages.product_id=p_build AND pages.revision_id=p_build
 AND pages.parent_id=h.root_id AND pages.field_name='pages'
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page ON page.product_id=p_build AND page.revision_id=p_build
 AND page.record_id=pages.record_id
 LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native page_size ON page_size.product_id=p_build
 AND page_size.revision_id=p_build
 AND page_size.record_id=page.structure_json->'fields'->'size'->>'target'
 WHERE h.product_id=p_build AND h.revision_id=p_build
 ) SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_region r LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_access a ON a.product_id=p_build AND a.revision_id=p_build AND a.pointer=r.pointer
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.native_json->'prov'->r.region_index::integer value) prov ON true
 LEFT JOIN page_sizes size ON size.member_key=r.page_no::text
 WHERE r.product_id=p_build AND (r.revision_id<>p_build OR a.pointer IS NULL OR prov.value IS NULL OR
 (prov.value->>'page_no')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM r.page_no OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_width),size.dimensions->'width') IS NOT TRUE OR
 ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_height),size.dimensions->'height') IS NOT TRUE OR
 to_jsonb(r.left) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'l' OR to_jsonb(r.top) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'t' OR
 to_jsonb(r.right) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'r' OR to_jsonb(r.bottom) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value->'bbox'->'b' OR

 RAISE EXCEPTION 'native access regions differ from native provenance/pages' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $$

catalog.arguments: p_build text, p_root text, p_projection jsonb
catalog.body:
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS (
  WITH RECURSIVE selected AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT r.pointer,r.parent_pointer,r.label,r.native_json
   FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_projection->'items') p(pointer)
   JOIN kb.pdf_record_access r ON r.pointer=p.pointer AND r.product_id=p_build
    AND r.revision_id=p_build AND r.content_layer='body'
   WHERE r.native_json->>'self_ref'=r.pointer
  ), walk(pointer,path,visited,in_cell,cell_index) AS (
   SELECT pointer,ARRAY[]::bigint[],ARRAY[pointer],false,NULL::bigint FROM selected WHERE pointer=p_root
   UNION ALL
   SELECT child.pointer,w.path||edge.n,w.visited||child.pointer,w.in_cell OR edge.in_cell,
    CASE WHEN edge.in_cell THEN edge.n-1 ELSE w.cell_index END
   FROM walk w JOIN selected parent USING(pointer)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c->>'$ref' AS pointer,n,false AS in_cell
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.native_json->'children') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
    WHERE parent.native_json->'data'->'table_cells' IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c->'ref'->>'$ref',n,true
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.native_json->'data'->'table_cells') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
    WHERE c->'ref'->>'$ref' IS NOT NULL
   ) edge JOIN selected child ON child.pointer=edge.pointer AND NOT child.pointer=ANY(w.visited)
  ), associations AS (
   SELECT DISTINCT ON (caption.pointer) caption.pointer,t.pointer AS owner,w.path,
    cardinality(w.path) AS depth,refs.family,refs.n
   FROM walk w JOIN selected t USING(pointer)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 0 AS family,n,c->>'$ref' AS pointer FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.native_json->'children') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1,n,c->>'$ref' FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.native_json->'captions') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
   ) refs JOIN selected caption ON caption.pointer=refs.pointer
   WHERE t.label='table' AND t.native_json->'data'->'table_cells' IS NOT NULL
    AND caption.label='caption' AND jsonb_typeof(caption.native_json->'text')='string'
    AND caption.native_json->>'text'<>''
    AND caption.parent_pointer=t.pointer
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM walk reached WHERE reached.pointer=caption.pointer)
   ORDER BY caption.pointer,w.path,refs.family,refs.n
  ), pieces AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT piece,n FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_projection->'pieces') WITH ORDINALITY p(piece,n)
   WHERE piece->>'kind'='native_text'
  ), captions AS (
   SELECT a.*,false AS ordinary,p.n AS position
   FROM associations a LEFT JOIN pieces p ON p.piece->>'item_ref'=a.pointer
    AND p.piece->>'source_field'='text' AND NOT p.piece ? 'cell_index'
   UNION ALL
   SELECT w.pointer,NULL,w.path,cardinality(w.path),NULL,NULL,true,p.n
   FROM walk w JOIN selected c USING(pointer)
   LEFT JOIN pieces p ON p.piece->>'item_ref'=w.pointer

   WHERE NOT w.in_cell AND c.label='caption' AND c.native_json->>'text'<>''
  )
  SELECT FROM captions a WHERE a.position IS NULL
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pieces p WHERE p.piece->>'item_ref'=a.pointer)<>1
   OR (NOT a.ordinary AND EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM pieces p WHERE p.n>a.position AND (
     (p.piece->>'item_ref'=a.owner AND p.piece->>'source_field'='cell_text')
     OR (p.piece ? 'cell_index' AND EXISTS(
      SELECT FROM walk rich WHERE rich.pointer=p.piece->>'item_ref' AND rich.in_cell
       AND rich.path[1:a.depth]=a.path
     ))
    )
   ))
   OR EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM captions prior WHERE prior.owner=a.owner
     AND (prior.family,prior.n)<(a.family,a.n) AND prior.position>=a.position
   )
   OR EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM pieces p JOIN walk w ON w.pointer=p.piece->>'item_ref' AND NOT w.in_cell

     AND ((w.path<a.path AND p.n>a.position) OR (w.path>a.path AND p.n<a.position))

   OR (p.piece ? 'cell_index' AND NOT EXISTS(

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.validate_projected_table_captions(p_build text,p_root text,p_projection jsonb)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $captions$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS (
  WITH RECURSIVE selected AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT r.pointer,r.parent_pointer,r.label,r.native_json
   FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_projection->'items') p(pointer)
   JOIN kb.pdf_record_access r ON r.pointer=p.pointer AND r.product_id=p_build
    AND r.revision_id=p_build AND r.content_layer='body'
   WHERE r.native_json->>'self_ref'=r.pointer
  ), walk(pointer,path,visited,in_cell,cell_index) AS (
   SELECT pointer,ARRAY[]::bigint[],ARRAY[pointer],false,NULL::bigint FROM selected WHERE pointer=p_root
   UNION ALL
   SELECT child.pointer,w.path||edge.n,w.visited||child.pointer,w.in_cell OR edge.in_cell,
    CASE WHEN edge.in_cell THEN edge.n-1 ELSE w.cell_index END
   FROM walk w JOIN selected parent USING(pointer)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c->>'$ref' AS pointer,n,false AS in_cell
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.native_json->'children') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
    WHERE parent.native_json->'data'->'table_cells' IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c->'ref'->>'$ref',n,true
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.native_json->'data'->'table_cells') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
    WHERE c->'ref'->>'$ref' IS NOT NULL
   ) edge JOIN selected child ON child.pointer=edge.pointer AND NOT child.pointer=ANY(w.visited)
  ), associations AS (
   SELECT DISTINCT ON (caption.pointer) caption.pointer,t.pointer AS owner,w.path,
    cardinality(w.path) AS depth,refs.family,refs.n
   FROM walk w JOIN selected t USING(pointer)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 0 AS family,n,c->>'$ref' AS pointer FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.native_json->'children') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1,n,c->>'$ref' FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.native_json->'captions') WITH ORDINALITY c(c,n)
   ) refs JOIN selected caption ON caption.pointer=refs.pointer
   WHERE t.label='table' AND t.native_json->'data'->'table_cells' IS NOT NULL
    AND caption.label='caption' AND jsonb_typeof(caption.native_json->'text')='string'
    AND caption.native_json->>'text'<>''
    AND caption.parent_pointer=t.pointer
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM walk reached WHERE reached.pointer=caption.pointer)
   ORDER BY caption.pointer,w.path,refs.family,refs.n
  ), pieces AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT piece,n FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_projection->'pieces') WITH ORDINALITY p(piece,n)
   WHERE piece->>'kind'='native_text'
  ), captions AS (
   SELECT a.*,false AS ordinary,p.n AS position
   FROM associations a LEFT JOIN pieces p ON p.piece->>'item_ref'=a.pointer
    AND p.piece->>'source_field'='text' AND NOT p.piece ? 'cell_index'
   UNION ALL
   SELECT w.pointer,NULL,w.path,cardinality(w.path),NULL,NULL,true,p.n
   FROM walk w JOIN selected c USING(pointer)
   LEFT JOIN pieces p ON p.piece->>'item_ref'=w.pointer
    AND p.piece->>'source_field'='text' AND NOT p.piece ? 'cell_index'
   WHERE NOT w.in_cell AND c.label='caption' AND c.native_json->>'text'<>''
  )
  SELECT FROM captions a WHERE a.position IS NULL
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pieces p WHERE p.piece->>'item_ref'=a.pointer)<>1
   OR (NOT a.ordinary AND EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM pieces p WHERE p.n>a.position AND (
     (p.piece->>'item_ref'=a.owner AND p.piece->>'source_field'='cell_text')
     OR (p.piece ? 'cell_index' AND EXISTS(
      SELECT FROM walk rich WHERE rich.pointer=p.piece->>'item_ref' AND rich.in_cell
       AND rich.path[1:a.depth]=a.path
     ))
    )
   ))
   OR EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM captions prior WHERE prior.owner=a.owner
     AND (prior.family,prior.n)<(a.family,a.n) AND prior.position>=a.position
   )
   OR EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM pieces p JOIN walk w ON w.pointer=p.piece->>'item_ref' AND NOT w.in_cell
    WHERE w.path<>a.path AND NOT p.piece ? 'cell_index'
     AND ((w.path<a.path AND p.n>a.position) OR (w.path>a.path AND p.n<a.position))
   )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT FROM pieces p JOIN selected c ON c.pointer=p.piece->>'item_ref'
  WHERE c.label='caption' AND (
   (NOT p.piece ? 'cell_index' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM captions a WHERE a.pointer=c.pointer))
   OR (p.piece ? 'cell_index' AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM walk rich WHERE rich.pointer=c.pointer AND rich.in_cell
     AND rich.cell_index=(p.piece->>'cell_index')::bigint AND p.piece->>'source_field'='text'
   ))
  )
 ) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'source view table caption projection differs from selected native occurrences' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
END $captions$

DECLARE manifest jsonb; archive jsonb; model jsonb; expected jsonb; actual jsonb; item jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(r,'start_run');
 manifest:=convert_from(manifest_content,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 archive:=convert_from(archive_content,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF manifest_content IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(data.canonical_json(manifest),'UTF8')
 OR archive_content IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(data.canonical_json(archive),'UTF8')
 OR runtime IS DISTINCT FROM 'runtime:'||encode(sha256(manifest_content),'hex') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime binding is not exact canonical content' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(manifest) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(archive) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(manifest) key)
  IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['execution_compiler_version','execution_model_id','implementation_inputs','python_version','release_id','semantic_inputs','version']
 OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(archive) key)
  IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['inputs','version']
 OR manifest->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'runtime-binding-1'
 OR archive->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'runtime-source-archive-1'
 OR manifest->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r
 OR manifest->>'execution_compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '27'
 OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'python_version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
 OR nullif(manifest->>'python_version','') IS NULL
 OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'semantic_inputs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'implementation_inputs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(archive->'inputs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported runtime binding contract' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT convert_from(body,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO STRICT model FROM sem.registry_row
 WHERE release_id=r AND kind='execution_model';
 IF manifest->>'execution_model_id' IS DISTINCT FROM model->>'model_id'
 OR model->'inputs'->>'compiler_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '27' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime binding belongs to another execution model' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',value->>0,'sha256',value->>1)
  ORDER BY (value->>0) COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(model->'implementation_digests');
 IF manifest->'semantic_inputs' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime semantic inputs differ from released meaning' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'implementation_inputs') LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(item) key) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['name','sha256']
  OR jsonb_typeof(item->'name') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR nullif(item->>'name','') IS NULL
  OR jsonb_typeof(item->'sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR item->>'sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'malformed runtime implementation input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(manifest->'implementation_inputs')=0
 OR (SELECT count(*)<>count(DISTINCT value->>'name') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'implementation_inputs'))
 OR (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'name') COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'implementation_inputs')) IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->'implementation_inputs' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime implementation inputs must be unique and ordered' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(archive->'inputs') LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(item) key) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['content_hex','name','sha256']
  OR jsonb_typeof(item->'name') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR nullif(item->>'name','') IS NULL
  OR jsonb_typeof(item->'content_hex') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR item->>'content_hex' !~ '^([0-9a-f]{2})*$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(item->'sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR item->>'sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(decode(item->>'content_hex','hex')),'hex') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime source archive differs from declared digest' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',value->>'name','sha256',value->>'sha256')
  ORDER BY position),'[]'::jsonb) INTO actual
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(archive->'inputs') WITH ORDINALITY inputs(value,position);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->'implementation_inputs' OR EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'semantic_inputs') semantic
  WHERE NOT manifest->'implementation_inputs' @> jsonb_build_array(semantic)
 ) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime source archive membership differs from manifest' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

  SELECT FROM data.record_assertion assertion
  JOIN data.record_assertion_support support ON
   (support.release_id,support.realization_id,support.record_id,support.interpretation_id,support.role,support.occurrence_id)=
   (assertion.release_id,assertion.realization_id,assertion.record_id,assertion.interpretation_id,assertion.role,assertion.occurrence_id)
  JOIN data.record_report_member member ON
   (member.release_id,member.realization_id,member.record_id,member.interpretation_id)=
   (assertion.release_id,assertion.realization_id,assertion.record_id,assertion.interpretation_id)
  JOIN data.record_report report ON
   (report.release_id,report.realization_id,report.selected_task_id,report.origin_task_id)=
   (member.release_id,member.realization_id,member.selected_task_id,support.origin_task_id)
  JOIN ops.cut_task cut_task ON (cut_task.cut_id,cut_task.task_id,cut_task.origin_task_id)=
   (report.cut_id,report.selected_task_id,support.origin_task_id)
  JOIN ops.input_cut cut ON cut.id=cut_task.cut_id AND cut.final AND cut.release_id=r
  JOIN ops.run job ON job.id=cut.run_id AND job.release_id=r AND job.result_realization_id=z
   AND job.sealed AND job.status IN ('consolidating','finished')
  JOIN ops.task selected ON selected.id=cut_task.task_id AND selected.run_id=job.id
   AND selected.release_id=r AND selected.status IN ('done','empty','reused')
   AND cut_task.origin_task_id=COALESCE(selected.reused_task_id,selected.id)
  JOIN ops.task origin ON origin.id=support.origin_task_id AND origin.release_id=r
  JOIN ops.task_result result ON result.task_id=origin.id
  JOIN ops.method_config config ON config.id=origin.method_config_id
  JOIN ops.method method ON method.id=config.method_id
  JOIN kb.source_view view ON origin.unit_type='source_view' AND view.id=origin.unit_id AND view.release_id=r
  JOIN kb.document document ON document.id=view.document_id
  JOIN data.occurrence occurrence ON
   (occurrence.release_id,occurrence.realization_id,occurrence.occurrence_id,occurrence.fact_id)=
   (assertion.release_id,assertion.realization_id,assertion.occurrence_id,assertion.fact_id)
  JOIN data.evidence evidence ON
   (evidence.release_id,evidence.realization_id,evidence.evidence_id)=(support.release_id,support.realization_id,support.evidence_id)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(result.body->'records','[]')) record_value
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'fields') field_value
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(record_value->'evidence_sets','[]')) set_value
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'anchors') anchor_value
  WHERE assertion.release_id=r AND assertion.realization_id=z AND assertion.occurrence_id=p_occurrence
   AND support.evidence_id=p_evidence
   AND (record_value->>'record_id',record_value->>'interpretation_id')=(assertion.record_id,assertion.interpretation_id)
   AND field_value->>'role'=assertion.role AND field_value->>'evidence_status'='available'
   AND (set_value->>'set_id',set_value->>'role')=(support.set_id,assertion.role)
   AND field_value->'evidence_sets' ? support.set_id
   AND anchor_value->>'anchor_id'=support.anchor_id AND set_value->'anchors' ? support.anchor_id
   AND occurrence.source=record_value->'pin'->>'source'
   AND occurrence.item=assertion.reading_id||'/'||assertion.role
   AND (evidence.source_uri,evidence.provider,evidence.operation_version)=
    (document.source_uri,method.name,method.version)
   AND evidence.evidence_id='reading-evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
    r,origin.id,record_value->'record_id',record_value->'interpretation_id',field_value->'role',set_value->'set_id',anchor_value->'anchor_id')),'UTF8')),'hex')
   AND evidence.locator::jsonb=jsonb_build_object('space',anchor_value->'space','pointer',anchor_value->'pointer',
    'precision',anchor_value->'precision','record_id',record_value->'record_id','interpretation_id',record_value->'interpretation_id',
    'role',field_value->'role','set_id',set_value->'set_id','anchor_id',anchor_value->'anchor_id')
    ||CASE WHEN anchor_value ? 'start' THEN jsonb_build_object('start',anchor_value->'start','end',anchor_value->'end') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
 )

  JOIN ops.input_cut cut ON cut.id=cut_task.cut_id AND cut.final AND cut.release_id=r
  JOIN ops.run job ON job.id=cut.run_id AND job.release_id=r AND job.result_realization_id=z
   AND job.sealed AND job.status IN ('consolidating','finished')
  JOIN ops.task selected ON selected.id=cut_task.task_id AND selected.run_id=job.id
   AND selected.release_id=r AND selected.status IN ('done','empty','reused')
   AND cut_task.origin_task_id=COALESCE(selected.reused_task_id,selected.id)
  JOIN ops.task origin ON origin.id=support.origin_task_id AND origin.release_id=r

  JOIN kb.source_view view ON origin.unit_type='source_view' AND view.id=origin.unit_id AND view.release_id=r

  JOIN data.occurrence occurrence ON

   (assertion.release_id,assertion.realization_id,assertion.occurrence_id,assertion.fact_id)
  JOIN data.evidence evidence ON
   (evidence.release_id,evidence.realization_id,evidence.evidence_id)=(support.release_id,support.realization_id,support.evidence_id)

  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'fields') field_value
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(record_value->'evidence_sets','[]')) set_value
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(record_value->'anchors') anchor_value
  WHERE assertion.release_id=r AND assertion.realization_id=z AND assertion.occurrence_id=p_occurrence
   AND support.evidence_id=p_evidence
   AND (record_value->>'record_id',record_value->>'interpretation_id')=(assertion.record_id,assertion.interpretation_id)
   AND field_value->>'role'=assertion.role AND field_value->>'evidence_status'='available'
   AND (set_value->>'set_id',set_value->>'role')=(support.set_id,assertion.role)
   AND field_value->'evidence_sets' ? support.set_id
   AND anchor_value->>'anchor_id'=support.anchor_id AND set_value->'anchors' ? support.anchor_id
   AND occurrence.source=record_value->'pin'->>'source'
   AND occurrence.item=assertion.reading_id||'/'||assertion.role
   AND (evidence.source_uri,evidence.provider,evidence.operation_version)=
    (document.source_uri,method.name,method.version)
   AND evidence.evidence_id='reading-evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
    r,origin.id,record_value->'record_id',record_value->'interpretation_id',field_value->'role',set_value->'set_id',anchor_value->'anchor_id')),'UTF8')),'hex')
   AND evidence.locator::jsonb=jsonb_build_object('space',anchor_value->'space','pointer',anchor_value->'pointer',
    'precision',anchor_value->'precision','record_id',record_value->'record_id','interpretation_id',record_value->'interpretation_id',
    'role',field_value->'role','set_id',set_value->'set_id','anchor_id',anchor_value->'anchor_id')
    ||CASE WHEN anchor_value ? 'start' THEN jsonb_build_object('start',anchor_value->'start','end',anchor_value->'end') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
 )

catalog.arguments: p_project text, p_run bigint, p_set bigint, p_family text, p_kind text
catalog.body:
DECLARE reference_set eval.reference_set; completed ops.completed_result; snapshot jsonb;
 units jsonb; method_name text; applicability jsonb; frame_unit jsonb; producer_report jsonb; prediction_record jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT reference_set FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=p_set AND project_id=p_project;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT completed FROM ops.completed_result WHERE run_id=p_run;
 IF p_kind NOT IN ('feature_fit','final_event_calibration') OR p_kind IS NULL
  OR p_family NOT IN ('definition','assertion','measurement','table','formula_context') OR p_family IS NULL
  OR reference_set.sampling->>'record_protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-reference-1'
  OR reference_set.sampling->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM p_kind
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.run WHERE id=p_run AND project_id=p_project) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy fitting requires a completed compatible run and declared fit partition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(completed.release_id,'reference_record_calibrate');
 applicability:=eval.record_reference_applicability(p_project,p_run,p_set);
 snapshot:=eval.native_reference_snapshot(p_set);
 IF jsonb_array_length(snapshot)=0 OR jsonb_array_length(snapshot)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM eval.reference_unit WHERE set_id=p_set) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy fitting needs every frozen source unit adjudicated, including empty units' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 method_name:=CASE p_kind WHEN 'feature_fit' THEN 'extract.m1_candidates' ELSE 'resolve.m1_readings' END;
 -- LEFT LATERAL preserves each independently selected no-output unit in coverage.
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'unit_id',u.id,'source_view_id',(binding.value->'prediction_frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin'->>'source_view_id')::bigint,
  'reference_source_view_id',u.source_view_id,'unit_key',u.unit_key,
  'prediction_frame',binding.value->'prediction_frame','correspondence',binding.value->'views',
  'origin_group',eligible->>'origin_group','source_frame',f.source_frame,
  'reference_records',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(rec ORDER BY ordinal) FROM
    jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(p.authored,'UTF8')::jsonb->'records') WITH ORDINALITY entry(rec,ordinal)
    WHERE rec->>'family'=p_family),'[]'::jsonb),
  'reports',COALESCE(reports.value,'[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY u.id) INTO units
 FROM eval.reference_unit u
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(snapshot) frozen ON (frozen->>'unit_id')::bigint=u.id
 JOIN eval.reference_pass p ON p.id=(frozen->>'pass_id')::bigint AND p.unit_id=u.id AND p.pass_kind='C'
 JOIN eval.reference_frame f ON f.id=(frozen->>'frame_id')::bigint AND f.pass_id=p.id
 JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(reference_set.sampling->'eligible_units') eligible
  ON eligible->>'unit_key'=u.unit_key
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT eval.record_reference_unit_binding(p_run,u.id,p.id,f.id) AS value) binding
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('selected_task_id',selected.id,'origin_task_id',origin.id,
    'source',COALESCE(result.body->>'source',selected.unit_key),'outcome',selected.status,
    'records',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(rec ORDER BY ordinal) FROM
      jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(result.body->'records','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY entry(rec,ordinal)
      WHERE rec->>'family'=p_family),'[]'::jsonb),
    'parse_detail',result.body->'parse_detail') ORDER BY selected.id) AS value
  FROM ops.cut_task ct JOIN ops.task selected ON selected.id=ct.task_id
  JOIN ops.task origin ON origin.id=ct.origin_task_id
  JOIN ops.method_config config ON config.id=selected.method_config_id
  JOIN ops.method method ON method.id=config.method_id
  LEFT JOIN ops.task_result result ON result.task_id=origin.id AND result.release_id=origin.release_id
  WHERE ct.cut_id=completed.cut_id AND selected.unit_type='source_view' AND selected.unit_id=(binding.value->'prediction_frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin'->>'source_view_id')::bigint
   AND method.name=method_name
   AND ct.origin_task_id=COALESCE(selected.reused_task_id,selected.id)
 ) reports ON true
 WHERE u.set_id=p_set;
 IF units IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(units)<>jsonb_array_length(snapshot)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(units) unit WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM ops.run_source_view WHERE run_id=p_run AND source_view_id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy fitting source frame is outside the completed source closure' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR frame_unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(units) LOOP
  FOR producer_report IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(frame_unit->'reports') LOOP
   PERFORM ops.validate_source_record_coordinates(p_run,(frame_unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint,
    frame_unit->'prediction_frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin'->>'source',producer_report->'records');
   FOR prediction_record IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(producer_report->'records') LOOP
    IF prediction_record->>'policy_version' IS DISTINCT FROM frame_unit->'prediction_frame'->'evaluation_frame'->>'prediction_policy_version' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy candidate differs from frozen evaluation policy' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    PERFORM data.validate_source_record_structure(completed.release_id,prediction_record);
    IF prediction_record->'pin' IS DISTINCT FROM frame_unit->'prediction_frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin' OR EXISTS(
     SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(prediction_record->'anchors') anchor WHERE NOT eval.record_reference_anchor_allowed(
      anchor,frame_unit->'correspondence',frame_unit->'source_frame'->'evaluation_frame')) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy candidate differs from authenticated mapped source cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('release_id',completed.release_id,'reference_release_id',reference_set.release_id,
  'applicability',applicability,'run_id',p_run,'set_id',p_set,
  'family',p_family,'kind',p_kind,'method',method_name,'units',units,
  'reference_digest',encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(snapshot),'UTF8')),'hex'));
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eval.record_policy_field_evidence(field jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('status',field->'evidence_status','sets',
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(field->'evidence_sets','[]'))),'[]'::jsonb),
  'alternatives',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(pair ORDER BY data.canonical_json(pair) COLLATE "C") FROM (
   SELECT jsonb_build_array(alternative->'value',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value COLLATE "C")
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(alternative->'evidence_sets','[]'))),'[]'::jsonb)) AS pair
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(field->'alternatives','[]')) alternative) ordered),'[]'::jsonb))
$$
ALTER FUNCTION eval.record_policy_field_evidence(jsonb) OWNER TO corpus_sem_publisher
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION eval.record_policy_field_evidence(jsonb) FROM PUBLIC

WITH predicted AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p_views IS NULL THEN
  jsonb_build_object('occurrence',candidate->'record_id','fields',candidate->'fields')
  ELSE eval.record_reference_comparison_record(candidate,p_views,'prediction') END AS value),
 expected AS (SELECT reference,CASE WHEN p_views IS NULL THEN
  jsonb_build_object('occurrence',reference->'record_id','fields',reference->'fields')
  ELSE eval.record_reference_comparison_record(reference,p_views,'reference') END AS value
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_references) reference)
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM expected reference,predicted
  WHERE reference.value->'occurrence'=predicted.value->'occurrence'
   AND reference.reference->>'family'=candidate->>'family'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(predicted.value->'fields') prediction
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(reference.value->'fields')
     WHERE value->>'role'=prediction->>'role') expected ON true
    WHERE expected.value IS NULL OR eval.record_policy_field_meaning(prediction) IS DISTINCT FROM eval.record_policy_field_meaning(expected.value)
     OR ((prediction->'meaning_changing'='true'::jsonb OR EXISTS(
       SELECT FROM sem.artifact artifact, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(artifact.content,'UTF8')::jsonb->'families') family,
        LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(family->'roles') role
       WHERE artifact.release_id=p_release AND artifact.artifact_name='record_projection.json'
        AND family->>'family'=candidate->>'family' AND role->>'role'=prediction->>'role' AND role->'required'='true'::jsonb)) AND
      eval.record_policy_field_evidence(prediction) IS DISTINCT FROM eval.record_policy_field_evidence(expected.value))))

DECLARE source_release text; contract json; input jsonb; unit jsonb; report jsonb; candidate jsonb; member jsonb; diagnostics jsonb;
 detail jsonb; event jsonb; events jsonb; feature jsonb; fit jsonb; calibration jsonb; acceptance jsonb;
 feature_eval eval.reference_evaluation; members jsonb:='[]'; coverage jsonb:='[]'; coverage_reports jsonb;
 positive bigint:=0; negative bigint:=0; origin_count bigint; exact_bytes text; count_members bigint:=0;
BEGIN
 SELECT c.release_id INTO STRICT source_release FROM ops.completed_result c JOIN ops.run r ON r.id=c.run_id
  JOIN eval.reference_set s ON s.id=p_set AND s.project_id=r.project_id WHERE c.run_id=p_run AND r.project_id=p_project;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(source_release,'reference_record_calibrate');
 SELECT convert_from(content,'UTF8')::json INTO STRICT contract FROM sem.artifact
  WHERE release_id=source_release AND artifact_name='json_schema/RecordPolicyCalibrationProduct';
 IF NOT public.json_matches_schema(contract,p_product::json)
  OR p_product->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-policy-fit-1'
  OR p_product->>'event_procedure' IS DISTINCT FROM 'independent-complete-reading-logistic-1' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy fit differs from released product/procedure contract' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 input:=eval.record_policy_prediction_frame(p_project,p_run,p_set,p_product->>'family',p_product->>'kind');
 feature:=p_product->'feature_instance';
 exact_bytes:=p_product->>'feature_canonical_json';
 IF exact_bytes::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM feature
  OR encode(sha256(convert_to(exact_bytes,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'feature_instance_digest'
  OR feature->'applicability'->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM source_release
  OR feature->'applicability'->>'family' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'family'
  OR feature->'applicability'->>'subset' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'subset'
  OR feature->'algorithm'->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'm1-grouped-reading-logistic-1'
  OR feature->'algorithm'->>'feature_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sealed-record-groups-1'
  OR feature->'algorithm'->>'solver' IS DISTINCT FROM 'lbfgs'
  OR (feature->'algorithm'->>'l1_ratio')::numeric<>0
  OR (feature->'algorithm'->>'inverse_regularization')::numeric<=0
  OR (feature->'algorithm'->>'tolerance')::numeric<=0
  OR jsonb_array_length(feature->'algorithm'->'features')<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT value->>'name')
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(feature->'algorithm'->'features'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(feature->'algorithm'->'features') f WHERE f->>'group' IS DISTINCT FROM
   CASE f->>'name' WHEN 'present_fraction' THEN 'structure' WHEN 'located_fraction' THEN 'evidence'
    WHEN 'exact_anchor_fraction' THEN 'evidence' WHEN 'unresolved_fraction' THEN 'semantics'
    WHEN 'classified_fraction' THEN 'semantics' WHEN 'changed_fraction' THEN 'transformation'
    WHEN 'alternative_count' THEN 'structure' WHEN 'diagnostic_count' THEN 'diagnostics' ELSE 'unsupported' END)
  OR feature->'parameters'->'positive_class' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
  OR feature->'algorithm'->'positive_class' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
  OR feature->'parameters'->'feature_signature' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(
    jsonb_build_array(feature->'algorithm'->'feature_version',feature->'algorithm'->'features')),'UTF8')),'hex'))
  OR feature->'parameters'->'names' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(value->'name' ORDER BY ordinal)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(feature->'algorithm'->'features') WITH ORDINALITY f(value,ordinal))
  OR jsonb_array_length(feature->'parameters'->'names')<>jsonb_array_length(feature->'parameters'->'coefficients')
  OR jsonb_array_length(feature->'parameters'->'names')<>jsonb_array_length(feature->'parameters'->'center')
  OR jsonb_array_length(feature->'parameters'->'names')<>jsonb_array_length(feature->'parameters'->'scale')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(feature->'parameters'->'scale') value WHERE value::numeric<=0) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy feature instance differs from exported algorithm/parameter authority' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p_product->>'kind'='feature_fit' THEN
  IF p_product ? 'acceptance_instance' OR p_product ? 'feature_evaluation_id' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature fitting cannot claim final-event calibration authority' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  fit:=feature->'fit';
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO STRICT feature_eval FROM eval.reference_evaluation WHERE id=(p_product->>'feature_evaluation_id')::bigint;
  IF feature_eval.content_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'feature_evaluation_digest'
   OR feature_eval.result->'policy_fit'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'feature_fit'
   OR feature_eval.result->'policy_fit'->>'feature_instance_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'feature_instance_digest'
   OR feature_eval.result->'policy_fit'->'feature_instance' IS DISTINCT FROM feature
   OR feature_eval.result->'policy_fit'->>'feature_canonical_json' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'feature_canonical_json' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'calibration must retain exact protected feature-fit instance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  -- Groups, URI copies and known identical bytes are compared across projects. Project
  -- separation alone is never evidence that held-out source origins are independent.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM eval.reference_set train JOIN eval.reference_set held ON held.id=p_set
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(train.sampling->'eligible_units') a
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(held.sampling->'eligible_units') b
    WHERE train.id=feature_eval.set_id AND a->>'origin_group'=b->>'origin_group')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM eval.reference_unit a JOIN kb.source_view av ON av.id=a.source_view_id
    JOIN kb.document ad ON ad.id=av.document_id, eval.reference_unit b JOIN kb.source_view bv ON bv.id=b.source_view_id
    JOIN kb.document bd ON bd.id=bv.document_id WHERE a.set_id=feature_eval.set_id AND b.set_id=p_set
     AND (ad.source_uri=bd.source_uri OR ad.content_hash=bd.content_hash)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'calibration and feature fitting share declared or known source origins' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  acceptance:=p_product->'acceptance_instance';
  exact_bytes:=p_product->>'instance_canonical_json';
  IF exact_bytes::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM acceptance
   OR encode(sha256(convert_to(exact_bytes,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'instance_digest'
   OR acceptance->'feature' IS DISTINCT FROM feature OR acceptance->'calibration' IS NULL
   OR acceptance->'calibration'='null'::jsonb
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'feature_instance_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'feature_instance_digest'
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'event_procedure' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'event_procedure'
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM 'held-out-final-event-sigmoid-1'
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'frame_selection' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete-predeclared-eligible-scored-events'
   OR (acceptance->>'threshold')::numeric<=0 OR (acceptance->>'threshold')::numeric>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'calibration export differs from exact instance/threshold contract' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  calibration:=acceptance->'calibration'; fit:=calibration->'fit';
 END IF;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'units') LOOP
  coverage_reports:='[]';
  FOR report IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(unit->'reports') LOOP
   coverage_reports:=coverage_reports||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('selected_task_id',report->'selected_task_id',
    'outcome',report->'outcome','records',jsonb_array_length(report->'records')));
   detail:=report->'parse_detail';
   FOR candidate IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(report->'records') LOOP
    SELECT value INTO member FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_product->'event_members')
     WHERE value->>'record_id'=candidate->>'record_id' AND value->>'interpretation_id'=candidate->>'interpretation_id'
      AND value->'selected_task_id'=report->'selected_task_id';
    IF member IS NULL OR member->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM report->'source'
     OR member->'correct' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(eval.record_policy_full_correct(source_release,candidate,unit->'reference_records',unit->'correspondence')) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy event label differs from complete sealed candidate/adjudicated reading' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF p_product->>'kind'='final_event_calibration' THEN
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(value),'[]'::jsonb) INTO events FROM jsonb_array_elements(
       COALESCE(data.report_field(detail,'record_policy_events')->'items','[]'))
      WHERE data.report_field(value,'record_id')->>'text'=candidate->>'record_id'
       AND data.report_field(value,'interpretation_id')->>'text'=candidate->>'interpretation_id'
       AND data.report_field(value,'feature_instance_digest')->>'text'=p_product->>'feature_instance_digest';
     event:=events->0;
     IF jsonb_array_length(events)<>1 OR data.report_field(event,'outcome')->>'text' IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
      OR data.report_field(event,'event_procedure')->>'text' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'event_procedure'
      OR data.report_field(event,'feature_input_digest')->>'text' IS DISTINCT FROM member->>'feature_input_digest'
      OR data.record_source_float(data.report_field(event,'final_event_score')) IS DISTINCT FROM (member->>'score')::double precision
      OR abs(data.record_source_float(data.report_field(event,'final_event_score'))-
       data.record_feature_score(candidate,data.record_source_json(data.report_field(event,'diagnostics')),feature))>
       greatest(1e-12,1e-12*abs(data.record_feature_score(candidate,
        data.record_source_json(data.report_field(event,'diagnostics')),feature)))
      OR (data.report_field(event,'feature_input_canonical_json')->>'text')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM
       jsonb_build_array(candidate,data.record_source_json(data.report_field(event,'diagnostics')))
      OR encode(sha256(convert_to(data.report_field(event,'feature_input_canonical_json')->>'text','UTF8')),'hex')
       IS DISTINCT FROM member->>'feature_input_digest' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'calibration must cover every sealed completed final event and its exact input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    ELSE
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(diagnostic ORDER BY report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) INTO diagnostics FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (data.canonical_json(diagnostic-'group')) diagnostic,report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal FROM (
       SELECT data.record_source_json(item) AS diagnostic,report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(data.report_field(detail,'reports')->'items','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY reports(value,report_ordinal)
       CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(data.report_field(value,'diagnostics')->'items','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY items(item,diagnostic_ordinal)
      ) raw WHERE candidate->'computation_dependencies' ? (diagnostic->>'group_dependency')
       AND diagnostic->>'group_dependency' LIKE 'native-group:%'
      ORDER BY data.canonical_json(diagnostic-'group'),report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal) unique_diagnostics;
     IF (member->>'score')::numeric<>0 OR member->>'feature_input_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM
      encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(candidate,diagnostics)),'UTF8')),'hex') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature-fit frame differs from exact sealed candidate/diagnostics input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END IF;
    members:=members||jsonb_build_array(member); count_members:=count_members+1;
    IF (member->>'correct')::boolean THEN positive:=positive+1; ELSE negative:=negative+1; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
  coverage:=coverage||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('unit_id',unit->'unit_id',
   'source_view_id',unit->'source_view_id','reports',coverage_reports));
 END LOOP;
 SELECT count(DISTINCT source_unit.value->>'origin_group') INTO origin_count
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'units') AS source_unit(value)
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_unit.value->'reports') AS selected_report(value)
   WHERE jsonb_array_length(selected_report.value->'records')>0);
 exact_bytes:=p_product->>'event_frame_canonical_json';
 IF count_members=0 OR members IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->'event_members'
  OR count_members<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT value->>'interpretation_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(members))
  OR exact_bytes::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM members
  OR encode(sha256(convert_to(exact_bytes,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'event_frame_digest'
  OR p_product->>'coverage_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(coverage),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR fit->>'coverage_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'coverage_digest'
  OR fit->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(input),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR fit->>'reference_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM input->>'reference_digest'
  OR fit->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'kind'
  OR fit->>'standing' IS DISTINCT FROM 'fitted' OR fit->'converged' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR fit->>'library_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'scikit-learn-1.9.1'
  OR (fit->>'positive_count')::bigint<>positive OR (fit->>'negative_count')::bigint<>negative
  OR (fit->>'declared_origin_group_count')::bigint<>origin_count
  OR least(positive,negative)<(feature->'algorithm'->>'minimum_per_class')::bigint
  OR origin_count<(feature->'algorithm'->>'minimum_origin_groups')::bigint
  OR (fit->>'iterations')::bigint<1 OR (fit->>'iterations')::bigint>=(feature->'algorithm'->>'max_iterations')::bigint
  OR (calibration IS NOT NULL AND (calibration->>'coverage_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'coverage_digest'
   OR calibration->'fit'->>'frame_digest'=feature->'fit'->>'frame_digest'
   OR calibration->'fit'->>'reference_digest'=feature->'fit'->>'reference_digest')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy fit has incomplete membership, support, convergence or immutable frame custody' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

    WHEN 'classified_fraction' THEN 'semantics' WHEN 'changed_fraction' THEN 'transformation'
    WHEN 'alternative_count' THEN 'structure' WHEN 'diagnostic_count' THEN 'diagnostics' ELSE 'unsupported' END)
  OR feature->'parameters'->'positive_class' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
  OR feature->'algorithm'->'positive_class' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb

    jsonb_build_array(feature->'algorithm'->'feature_version',feature->'algorithm'->'features')),'UTF8')),'hex'))

   FROM jsonb_array_elements(feature->'algorithm'->'features') WITH ORDINALITY f(value,ordinal))

  SELECT * INTO STRICT feature_eval FROM eval.reference_evaluation WHERE id=(p_product->>'feature_evaluation_id')::bigint;

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(train.sampling->'eligible_units') a
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(held.sampling->'eligible_units') b
    WHERE train.id=feature_eval.set_id AND a->>'origin_group'=b->>'origin_group')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM eval.reference_unit a JOIN kb.source_view av ON av.id=a.source_view_id
    JOIN kb.document ad ON ad.id=av.document_id, eval.reference_unit b JOIN kb.source_view bv ON bv.id=b.source_view_id
    JOIN kb.document bd ON bd.id=bv.document_id WHERE a.set_id=feature_eval.set_id AND b.set_id=p_set
     AND (ad.source_uri=bd.source_uri OR ad.content_hash=bd.content_hash)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'calibration and feature fitting share declared or known source origins' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  acceptance:=p_product->'acceptance_instance';
  exact_bytes:=p_product->>'instance_canonical_json';
  IF exact_bytes::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM acceptance
   OR encode(sha256(convert_to(exact_bytes,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'instance_digest'
   OR acceptance->'feature' IS DISTINCT FROM feature OR acceptance->'calibration' IS NULL
   OR acceptance->'calibration'='null'::jsonb
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'feature_instance_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'feature_instance_digest'
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'event_procedure' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'event_procedure'
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM 'held-out-final-event-sigmoid-1'
   OR acceptance->'calibration'->>'frame_selection' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete-predeclared-eligible-scored-events'
   OR (acceptance->>'threshold')::numeric<=0 OR (acceptance->>'threshold')::numeric>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'calibration export differs from exact instance/threshold contract' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  calibration:=acceptance->'calibration'; fit:=calibration->'fit';
 END IF;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'units') LOOP
  coverage_reports:='[]';
  FOR report IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(unit->'reports') LOOP
   coverage_reports:=coverage_reports||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('selected_task_id',report->'selected_task_id',
    'outcome',report->'outcome','records',jsonb_array_length(report->'records')));
   detail:=report->'parse_detail';
   FOR candidate IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(report->'records') LOOP
    SELECT value INTO member FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_product->'event_members')
     WHERE value->>'record_id'=candidate->>'record_id' AND value->>'interpretation_id'=candidate->>'interpretation_id'
      AND value->'selected_task_id'=report->'selected_task_id';
    IF member IS NULL OR member->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM report->'source'
     OR member->'correct' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(eval.record_policy_full_correct(source_release,candidate,unit->'reference_records',unit->'correspondence')) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy event label differs from complete sealed candidate/adjudicated reading' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF p_product->>'kind'='final_event_calibration' THEN
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(value),'[]'::jsonb) INTO events FROM jsonb_array_elements(
       COALESCE(data.report_field(detail,'record_policy_events')->'items','[]'))
      WHERE data.report_field(value,'record_id')->>'text'=candidate->>'record_id'
       AND data.report_field(value,'interpretation_id')->>'text'=candidate->>'interpretation_id'
       AND data.report_field(value,'feature_instance_digest')->>'text'=p_product->>'feature_instance_digest';
     event:=events->0;
     IF jsonb_array_length(events)<>1 OR data.report_field(event,'outcome')->>'text' IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
      OR data.report_field(event,'event_procedure')->>'text' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'event_procedure'
      OR data.report_field(event,'feature_input_digest')->>'text' IS DISTINCT FROM member->>'feature_input_digest'
      OR data.record_source_float(data.report_field(event,'final_event_score')) IS DISTINCT FROM (member->>'score')::double precision
      OR abs(data.record_source_float(data.report_field(event,'final_event_score'))-
       data.record_feature_score(candidate,data.record_source_json(data.report_field(event,'diagnostics')),feature))>
       greatest(1e-12,1e-12*abs(data.record_feature_score(candidate,
        data.record_source_json(data.report_field(event,'diagnostics')),feature)))
      OR (data.report_field(event,'feature_input_canonical_json')->>'text')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM
       jsonb_build_array(candidate,data.record_source_json(data.report_field(event,'diagnostics')))
      OR encode(sha256(convert_to(data.report_field(event,'feature_input_canonical_json')->>'text','UTF8')),'hex')
       IS DISTINCT FROM member->>'feature_input_digest' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'calibration must cover every sealed completed final event and its exact input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    ELSE
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(diagnostic ORDER BY report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) INTO diagnostics FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (data.canonical_json(diagnostic-'group')) diagnostic,report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal FROM (
       SELECT data.record_source_json(item) AS diagnostic,report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(data.report_field(detail,'reports')->'items','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY reports(value,report_ordinal)
       CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(data.report_field(value,'diagnostics')->'items','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY items(item,diagnostic_ordinal)
      ) raw WHERE candidate->'computation_dependencies' ? (diagnostic->>'group_dependency')
       AND diagnostic->>'group_dependency' LIKE 'native-group:%'
      ORDER BY data.canonical_json(diagnostic-'group'),report_ordinal,diagnostic_ordinal) unique_diagnostics;
     IF (member->>'score')::numeric<>0 OR member->>'feature_input_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM
      encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(candidate,diagnostics)),'UTF8')),'hex') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature-fit frame differs from exact sealed candidate/diagnostics input' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END IF;
    members:=members||jsonb_build_array(member); count_members:=count_members+1;
    IF (member->>'correct')::boolean THEN positive:=positive+1; ELSE negative:=negative+1; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
  coverage:=coverage||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('unit_id',unit->'unit_id',
   'source_view_id',unit->'source_view_id','reports',coverage_reports));
 END LOOP;
 SELECT count(DISTINCT source_unit.value->>'origin_group') INTO origin_count
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'units') AS source_unit(value)
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_unit.value->'reports') AS selected_report(value)
   WHERE jsonb_array_length(selected_report.value->'records')>0);
 exact_bytes:=p_product->>'event_frame_canonical_json';
 IF count_members=0 OR members IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->'event_members'
  OR count_members<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT value->>'interpretation_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(members))
  OR exact_bytes::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM members
  OR encode(sha256(convert_to(exact_bytes,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'event_frame_digest'
  OR p_product->>'coverage_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(coverage),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR fit->>'coverage_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'coverage_digest'
  OR fit->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(input),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR fit->>'reference_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM input->>'reference_digest'
  OR fit->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'kind'
  OR fit->>'standing' IS DISTINCT FROM 'fitted' OR fit->'converged' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR fit->>'library_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'scikit-learn-1.9.1'
  OR (fit->>'positive_count')::bigint<>positive OR (fit->>'negative_count')::bigint<>negative
  OR (fit->>'declared_origin_group_count')::bigint<>origin_count
  OR least(positive,negative)<(feature->'algorithm'->>'minimum_per_class')::bigint
  OR origin_count<(feature->'algorithm'->>'minimum_origin_groups')::bigint
  OR (fit->>'iterations')::bigint<1 OR (fit->>'iterations')::bigint>=(feature->'algorithm'->>'max_iterations')::bigint
  OR (calibration IS NOT NULL AND (calibration->>'coverage_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_product->>'coverage_digest'
   OR calibration->'fit'->>'frame_digest'=feature->'fit'->>'frame_digest'
   OR calibration->'fit'->>'reference_digest'=feature->'fit'->>'reference_digest')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy fit has incomplete membership, support, convergence or immutable frame custody' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $$

DECLARE contract json; evaluation eval.reference_evaluation; product jsonb; instance jsonb; exact_bytes text;
BEGIN
 SELECT convert_from(content,'UTF8')::json INTO STRICT contract FROM sem.artifact
  WHERE release_id=p_release AND artifact_name='json_schema/RecordPolicyBinding';
 IF NOT public.json_matches_schema(contract,p_binding::json) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record policy binding differs from released schema' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 instance:=p_binding->'instance'; exact_bytes:=p_binding->>'instance_canonical_json';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT evaluation FROM eval.reference_evaluation WHERE id=(p_binding->>'evaluation_id')::bigint;
 product:=evaluation.result->'policy_fit';
 IF evaluation.content_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_binding->>'evaluation_digest'
  OR evaluation.result->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_release
  OR exact_bytes::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM instance
  OR encode(sha256(convert_to(exact_bytes,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_binding->>'instance_digest'
  OR product->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'final_event_calibration'
  OR product->'acceptance_instance' IS DISTINCT FROM instance
  OR product->>'instance_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_binding->>'instance_digest'
  OR product->>'instance_canonical_json' IS DISTINCT FROM exact_bytes
  OR instance->'feature'->'applicability'->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_release
  OR (p_accept AND (instance->'calibration' IS NULL OR instance->'calibration'='null'::jsonb)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record admission requires an exact protected evaluator-authorized instance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 -- Protected immutable insertion authenticated the complete numerical/reference frame.
 -- Later adjudication does not silently rebind or revoke this frozen instance.
 IF evaluation.content_digest IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(
   jsonb_build_object('snapshot',evaluation.reference_snapshot,'result',evaluation.result)),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=evaluation.set_id
   AND sampling->>'partition'='final_event_calibration'
   AND evaluation.result->>'reference_release_id'=release_id)
  OR evaluation.result->'applicability'->>'prediction_release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_release THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record policy evaluation custody differs from immutable protected bytes' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(p_release,'reference_record_calibrate');
END

DECLARE view kb.source_view; document kb.document; recipe bytea;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT view FROM kb.source_view WHERE id=p_view;

 SELECT content INTO STRICT recipe FROM kb.source_artifact WHERE artifact_digest=view.recipe_digest;
 IF view.projection_digest IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(view.projection),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR view.recipe_digest IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(recipe),'hex')

   AND build_id=view.native_build_id AND build_id=view.native_revision_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'reference physical source custody/digests unavailable or changed' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('document_id',document.id,'document_key',document.key,
  'source_uri',document.source_uri,'content_hash',document.content_hash,
  'native_product_task_id',view.native_task_id,'product_key',view.native_product_key,'product_digest',view.native_content_digest,

  'projection_digest',view.projection_digest,'projection',view.projection);

DECLARE result bigint; source_release text; unit jsonb; metadata jsonb; group_snapshot jsonb; unit_id bigint; unit_snapshot jsonb; frozen_frame jsonb; source_cut bigint; membership_snapshot jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT release_id INTO STRICT source_release FROM ops.run WHERE id=p_run AND project_id=p_project FOR UPDATE;
 source_cut:=COALESCE((p_sampling->>'source_cut_id')::bigint,(SELECT cut_id FROM ops.completed_result WHERE run_id=p_run));
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.input_cut WHERE id=source_cut AND run_id=p_run AND release_id=source_release) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record references require an explicitly sealed source-ready cut or completed source cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(source_release,'reference_record_set');
 IF p_split NOT IN ('dev','test') OR p_split IS NULL OR p_guideline IS NULL OR btrim(p_guideline)=''
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_units) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_units)=0
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR p_sampling->>'record_protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-reference-1'
  OR p_sampling->>'source_frame_abi' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-frame-1'
  OR p_sampling->>'partition' NOT IN ('development','feature_fit','final_event_calibration','final_assessment')
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'guideline_text',''))=''
  OR p_sampling->>'guideline_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(p_sampling->>'guideline_text','UTF8')),'hex')
  OR NOT(p_sampling ?& ARRAY['seed','strata','inclusion_probabilities','provenance','cohort','partition','reference_policy_version','prediction_policy_version'])
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'seed') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_sampling->>'seed') !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'strata') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'provenance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR p_sampling->'provenance'='{}'
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'cohort',''))='' OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'reference_policy_version',''))=''
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'prediction_policy_version',''))='' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample requires frozen guideline, partition, seed, strata, inclusion and provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_units)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u->>'unit_key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'))<>jsonb_array_length(p_units) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample repeats or omits eligible unit probabilities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.source_view v JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id
   JOIN eval.document_split legacy ON legacy.project_id=p_project AND legacy.source_uri=d.source_uri AND legacy.split=p_split
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group
   WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND d.project_id=p_project
    AND origin.partition=p_sampling->>'partition')
   OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->(unit->>'unit_key')) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR NOT(0<(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric
    AND (p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric<=1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'sample unit is outside immutable origin partition/legacy split or lacks inclusion probability' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(groups) ORDER BY groups.origin_group) INTO group_snapshot FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT origin.* FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
  JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
  JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group) groups;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(u||jsonb_build_object('origin_group',member.origin_group,'source_uri',d.source_uri) ORDER BY u->>'unit_key')
 INTO unit_snapshot FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
 JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(member) ORDER BY source_view_id) INTO membership_snapshot FROM ops.run_source_view member WHERE run_id=p_run;
 metadata:=p_sampling||jsonb_build_object('origin_groups',group_snapshot,'eligible_units',unit_snapshot,
  'source_cut_id',source_cut,'source_membership',membership_snapshot,'membership_snapshot_kind','reference_set_creation');
 INSERT INTO eval.reference_set(project_id,release_id,source_run_id,label,split,guideline,sampling)
 VALUES(p_project,source_release,p_run,p_label,p_split,p_guideline,metadata) RETURNING id INTO result;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  SELECT unit->'frame'||jsonb_build_object('source_views',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) ORDER BY v.id)) INTO frozen_frame
  FROM kb.source_view v WHERE v.id IN (
   SELECT (unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin'->>'source_view_id')::bigint UNION ALL
   SELECT (pin->>'source_view_id')::bigint FROM jsonb_array_elements(unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'related_pins') pin);

  SELECT result,v.id,v.projection_digest,unit->>'unit_key',jsonb_build_array(frozen_frame) FROM kb.source_view v
  WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(membership_snapshot) m WHERE (m->>'source_view_id')::bigint=v.id)
  RETURNING id INTO STRICT unit_id;
  PERFORM eval.validate_source_record_reference_frame(unit_id,jsonb_build_object(
   'protocol','source-record-reference-1','release_id',source_release,'unit_ref',unit->>'unit_key',

   'prediction_policy_version',p_sampling->>'prediction_policy_version','reason','source-only frame freeze','records','[]'::jsonb),frozen_frame);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eval.create_source_record_reference_set(p_project text,p_run bigint,p_label text,p_split text,p_guideline text,p_sampling jsonb,p_units jsonb)
RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE result bigint; source_release text; unit jsonb; metadata jsonb; group_snapshot jsonb; unit_id bigint; unit_snapshot jsonb; frozen_frame jsonb; source_cut bigint; membership_snapshot jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT release_id INTO STRICT source_release FROM ops.run WHERE id=p_run AND project_id=p_project FOR UPDATE;
 source_cut:=COALESCE((p_sampling->>'source_cut_id')::bigint,(SELECT cut_id FROM ops.completed_result WHERE run_id=p_run));
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.input_cut WHERE id=source_cut AND run_id=p_run AND release_id=source_release) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record references require an explicitly sealed source-ready cut or completed source cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(source_release,'reference_record_set');
 IF p_split NOT IN ('dev','test') OR p_split IS NULL OR p_guideline IS NULL OR btrim(p_guideline)=''
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_units) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_units)=0
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR p_sampling->>'record_protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-reference-1'
  OR p_sampling->>'source_frame_abi' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-frame-1'
  OR p_sampling->>'partition' NOT IN ('development','feature_fit','final_event_calibration','final_assessment')
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'guideline_text',''))=''
  OR p_sampling->>'guideline_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(p_sampling->>'guideline_text','UTF8')),'hex')
  OR NOT(p_sampling ?& ARRAY['seed','strata','inclusion_probabilities','provenance','cohort','partition','reference_policy_version','prediction_policy_version'])
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'seed') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_sampling->>'seed') !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'strata') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'provenance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR p_sampling->'provenance'='{}'
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'cohort',''))='' OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'reference_policy_version',''))=''
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'prediction_policy_version',''))='' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample requires frozen guideline, partition, seed, strata, inclusion and provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_units)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u->>'unit_key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'))<>jsonb_array_length(p_units) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample repeats or omits eligible unit probabilities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.source_view v JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id
   JOIN eval.document_split legacy ON legacy.project_id=p_project AND legacy.source_uri=d.source_uri AND legacy.split=p_split
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group
   WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND d.project_id=p_project
    AND origin.partition=p_sampling->>'partition')
   OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->(unit->>'unit_key')) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR NOT(0<(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric
    AND (p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric<=1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'sample unit is outside immutable origin partition/legacy split or lacks inclusion probability' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(groups) ORDER BY groups.origin_group) INTO group_snapshot FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT origin.* FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
  JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
  JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group) groups;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(u||jsonb_build_object('origin_group',member.origin_group,'source_uri',d.source_uri) ORDER BY u->>'unit_key')
 INTO unit_snapshot FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
 JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(member) ORDER BY source_view_id) INTO membership_snapshot FROM ops.run_source_view member WHERE run_id=p_run;
 metadata:=p_sampling||jsonb_build_object('origin_groups',group_snapshot,'eligible_units',unit_snapshot,
  'source_cut_id',source_cut,'source_membership',membership_snapshot,'membership_snapshot_kind','reference_set_creation');
 INSERT INTO eval.reference_set(project_id,release_id,source_run_id,label,split,guideline,sampling)
 VALUES(p_project,source_release,p_run,p_label,p_split,p_guideline,metadata) RETURNING id INTO result;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  SELECT unit->'frame'||jsonb_build_object('source_views',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) ORDER BY v.id)) INTO frozen_frame
  FROM kb.source_view v WHERE v.id IN (
   SELECT (unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin'->>'source_view_id')::bigint UNION ALL
   SELECT (pin->>'source_view_id')::bigint FROM jsonb_array_elements(unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'related_pins') pin);
  INSERT INTO eval.reference_unit(set_id,source_view_id,projection_digest,unit_key,context)
  SELECT result,v.id,v.projection_digest,unit->>'unit_key',jsonb_build_array(frozen_frame) FROM kb.source_view v
  WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(membership_snapshot) m WHERE (m->>'source_view_id')::bigint=v.id)
  RETURNING id INTO STRICT unit_id;
  PERFORM eval.validate_source_record_reference_frame(unit_id,jsonb_build_object(
   'protocol','source-record-reference-1','release_id',source_release,'unit_ref',unit->>'unit_key',
   'guideline',p_guideline,'reference_policy_version',p_sampling->>'reference_policy_version',
   'prediction_policy_version',p_sampling->>'prediction_policy_version','reason','source-only frame freeze','records','[]'::jsonb),frozen_frame);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN result;
END $$

DECLARE source_release text; reference_release text; item jsonb; payload jsonb; frozen jsonb; report_schema json; applicability jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT release_id INTO STRICT reference_release FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=p_set AND project_id=p_project;
 SELECT c.release_id INTO STRICT source_release FROM ops.completed_result c JOIN ops.run r ON r.id=c.run_id WHERE c.run_id=p_run AND r.project_id=p_project;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(source_release,'reference_record_grade');
 applicability:=eval.record_reference_applicability(p_project,p_run,p_set);
 IF p_result->'applicability' IS DISTINCT FROM applicability OR p_result->>'reference_release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_release THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade reference applicability differs from native authenticated correspondence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT convert_from(content,'UTF8')::json INTO STRICT report_schema FROM sem.artifact
 WHERE release_id=source_release AND artifact_name='json_schema/ReferenceRecordEvaluationReport';
 IF NOT public.json_matches_schema(report_schema,p_result::json)
  OR p_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM eval.native_reference_snapshot(p_set)
  OR jsonb_array_length(p_snapshot)=0
  OR jsonb_array_length(p_snapshot)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM eval.reference_unit WHERE set_id=p_set)
  OR jsonb_array_length(p_result->'units')<>jsonb_array_length(p_snapshot)
  OR (p_result->>'reference_units_scored')::bigint<>jsonb_array_length(p_snapshot) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade has a malformed report or incomplete frozen snapshot' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 -- Bind each reported unit by identity, independently of array order. A same-length
 -- duplicate or foreign unit must not erase an empty/unrouted member of the population.
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_result->'units')<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT reported->>'unit') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_snapshot) snap
   JOIN eval.reference_unit u ON u.id=(snap->>'unit_id')::bigint AND u.set_id=p_set
   JOIN eval.reference_frame f ON f.id=(snap->>'frame_id')::bigint AND f.pass_id=(snap->>'pass_id')::bigint
   JOIN eval.reference_set s ON s.id=u.set_id
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.sampling->'eligible_units') eligible
   WHERE reported->>'unit'=u.unit_key AND eligible->>'unit_key'=u.unit_key
    AND (eligible->>'source_view_id')::bigint=u.source_view_id
    AND reported->>'origin_group'=eligible->>'origin_group'
    AND reported->>'release_id'=source_release AND reported->>'reference_release_id'=s.release_id
    AND reported->>'guideline_version'=f.source_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'guideline_version'
    AND reported->>'reference_policy_version'=f.source_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'reference_policy_version'
    AND reported->>'prediction_policy_version'=f.source_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'prediction_policy_version')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade unit population/origin/version binding differs from frozen snapshot' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p_result->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-record-evaluation-1'
  OR p_result->>'family' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source_records'
  OR p_result->>'comparison_policy' IS DISTINCT FROM 'strict-source-occurrence-1'
  OR p_result->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM source_release
  OR p_result->>'quality_claim' IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_established'
  OR p_result->>'output_realization_id' IS DISTINCT FROM
   (SELECT c.output_realization_id FROM ops.completed_result c JOIN ops.run r ON r.id=c.run_id
    WHERE c.run_id=p_run AND c.release_id=source_release AND r.project_id=p_project)
  OR p_result->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT sampling->>'partition' FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=p_set)
  OR p_result->>'sampling_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(sampling::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=p_set) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade differs from frozen release/partition/completed publication' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_snapshot) LOOP
  SELECT convert_from(authored,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO STRICT payload FROM eval.reference_pass WHERE id=(item->>'pass_id')::bigint;
  SELECT source_frame INTO STRICT frozen FROM eval.reference_frame WHERE id=(item->>'frame_id')::bigint AND pass_id=(item->>'pass_id')::bigint;
  PERFORM eval.validate_source_record_reference_frame((item->>'unit_id')::bigint,payload,frozen);
  IF (SELECT reported->'gap_evidence' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported
   JOIN eval.reference_unit u ON u.id=(item->>'unit_id')::bigint AND reported->>'unit'=u.unit_key)
   IS DISTINCT FROM eval.source_record_gap_evidence(p_run,(item->>'unit_id')::bigint,
    (item->>'pass_id')::bigint,(item->>'frame_id')::bigint) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record gaps differ from complete independent C/native publication evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported JOIN eval.reference_unit u
    ON u.id=(item->>'unit_id')::bigint AND reported->>'unit'=u.unit_key
    WHERE reported->'match_bindings' IS DISTINCT FROM reported->'gap_evidence'->'match_bindings'
     OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM unnest(ARRAY['core','full','evidence']) tier WHERE reported->'matches'->tier IS DISTINCT FROM
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(binding->'reference_record_id' ORDER BY binding->>'reference_record_id'),'[]'::jsonb)
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(reported->'gap_evidence'->'match_bindings') binding WHERE binding->'tiers' ? tier))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade matches differ from authenticated original/prediction identities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF (SELECT reported->'correspondence' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported
   JOIN eval.reference_unit u ON u.id=(item->>'unit_id')::bigint AND reported->>'unit'=u.unit_key)
   IS DISTINCT FROM eval.record_reference_unit_binding(p_run,(item->>'unit_id')::bigint,
    (item->>'pass_id')::bigint,(item->>'frame_id')::bigint)->'views' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade comparison closure differs from authenticated correspondence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF p_result ? 'policy_fit' THEN
  PERFORM eval.validate_record_policy_product(p_project,p_run,p_set,p_result->'policy_fit');
 END IF;
 END

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade reference applicability differs from native authenticated correspondence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 WHERE release_id=source_release AND artifact_name='json_schema/ReferenceRecordEvaluationReport';
