  OR p_result->>'family' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source_records'
  OR p_result->>'comparison_policy' IS DISTINCT FROM 'strict-source-occurrence-1'
  OR p_result->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM source_release
  OR p_result->>'quality_claim' IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_established'
  OR p_result->>'output_realization_id' IS DISTINCT FROM
   (SELECT c.output_realization_id FROM ops.completed_result c JOIN ops.run r ON r.id=c.run_id
    WHERE c.run_id=p_run AND c.release_id=source_release AND r.project_id=p_project)
  OR p_result->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT sampling->>'partition' FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=p_set)
  OR p_result->>'sampling_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(sampling::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=p_set) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade differs from frozen release/partition/completed publication' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_snapshot) LOOP
  SELECT convert_from(authored,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO STRICT payload FROM eval.reference_pass WHERE id=(item->>'pass_id')::bigint;
  SELECT source_frame INTO STRICT frozen FROM eval.reference_frame WHERE id=(item->>'frame_id')::bigint AND pass_id=(item->>'pass_id')::bigint;
  PERFORM eval.validate_source_record_reference_frame((item->>'unit_id')::bigint,payload,frozen);
  IF (SELECT reported->'gap_evidence' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported
   JOIN eval.reference_unit u ON u.id=(item->>'unit_id')::bigint AND reported->>'unit'=u.unit_key)
   IS DISTINCT FROM eval.source_record_gap_evidence(p_run,(item->>'unit_id')::bigint,
    (item->>'pass_id')::bigint,(item->>'frame_id')::bigint) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record gaps differ from complete independent C/native publication evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported JOIN eval.reference_unit u
    ON u.id=(item->>'unit_id')::bigint AND reported->>'unit'=u.unit_key
    WHERE reported->'match_bindings' IS DISTINCT FROM reported->'gap_evidence'->'match_bindings'
     OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM unnest(ARRAY['core','full','evidence']) tier WHERE reported->'matches'->tier IS DISTINCT FROM
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(binding->'reference_record_id' ORDER BY binding->>'reference_record_id'),'[]'::jsonb)
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(reported->'gap_evidence'->'match_bindings') binding WHERE binding->'tiers' ? tier))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade matches differ from authenticated original/prediction identities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF (SELECT reported->'correspondence' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') reported
   JOIN eval.reference_unit u ON u.id=(item->>'unit_id')::bigint AND reported->>'unit'=u.unit_key)
   IS DISTINCT FROM eval.record_reference_unit_binding(p_run,(item->>'unit_id')::bigint,
    (item->>'pass_id')::bigint,(item->>'frame_id')::bigint)->'views' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record grade comparison closure differs from authenticated correspondence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF p_result ? 'policy_fit' THEN
  PERFORM eval.validate_record_policy_product(p_project,p_run,p_set,p_result->'policy_fit');
 END IF;

 -- Privileges alone are insufficient: refuse evaluator credentials, SET ROLE and role
 -- inheritance that could also reveal calibration/final labels through another route.

  OR pg_has_role(principal,'corpus_sem_evaluator','MEMBER') OR pg_has_role(principal,'corpus_sem_publisher','MEMBER')

  OR has_database_privilege(principal,current_database(),'TEMP')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE oid=principal::regrole AND (rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolbypassrls OR rolreplication))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='eval'
   AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m') AND (has_table_privilege(principal,c.oid,'SELECT')

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'fitting requires a restricted actual fitting principal' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

DECLARE result bigint; source_release text; unit jsonb; metadata jsonb; group_snapshot jsonb; unit_id bigint; unit_snapshot jsonb; frozen_frame jsonb; source_cut bigint; membership_snapshot jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT release_id INTO STRICT source_release FROM ops.run WHERE id=p_run AND project_id=p_project FOR UPDATE;
 source_cut:=COALESCE((p_sampling->>'source_cut_id')::bigint,(SELECT cut_id FROM ops.completed_result WHERE run_id=p_run));
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.input_cut WHERE id=source_cut AND run_id=p_run AND release_id=source_release) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record references require an explicitly sealed source-ready cut or completed source cut' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(source_release,'reference_operation_set');
 IF p_split NOT IN ('dev','test') OR p_split IS NULL OR p_guideline IS NULL OR btrim(p_guideline)=''
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_units) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_units)=0
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR p_sampling->>'operation_protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-operation-reference-1'
  OR COALESCE(p_sampling->>'source_frame_abi','') NOT IN ('source-operation-frame-1','source-operation-frame-2')
  OR p_sampling->>'partition' NOT IN ('development','feature_fit','final_event_calibration','final_assessment')
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'guideline_text',''))=''
  OR p_sampling->>'guideline_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(p_sampling->>'guideline_text','UTF8')),'hex')
  OR NOT(p_sampling ?& ARRAY['seed','strata','inclusion_probabilities','provenance','cohort','partition'])
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'seed') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_sampling->>'seed') !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'strata') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'provenance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR p_sampling->'provenance'='{}'
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'cohort',''))='' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample requires frozen guideline, partition, seed, strata, inclusion and provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_units)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u->>'unit_key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'))<>jsonb_array_length(p_units) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample repeats or omits eligible unit probabilities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.source_view v JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id
   JOIN eval.document_split legacy ON legacy.project_id=p_project AND legacy.source_uri=d.source_uri AND legacy.split=p_split
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group
   WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND d.project_id=p_project
    AND origin.partition=p_sampling->>'partition')
   OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->(unit->>'unit_key')) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR NOT(0<(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric
    AND (p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric<=1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'sample unit is outside immutable origin partition/legacy split or lacks inclusion probability' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(groups) ORDER BY groups.origin_group) INTO group_snapshot FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT origin.* FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
  JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
  JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group) groups;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(u||jsonb_build_object('origin_group',member.origin_group,'source_uri',d.source_uri) ORDER BY u->>'unit_key')
 INTO unit_snapshot FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
 JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(member) ORDER BY source_view_id) INTO membership_snapshot FROM ops.run_source_view member WHERE run_id=p_run;
 metadata:=p_sampling||jsonb_build_object('origin_groups',group_snapshot,'eligible_units',unit_snapshot,
  'source_cut_id',source_cut,'source_membership',membership_snapshot,'membership_snapshot_kind','reference_set_creation');
 INSERT INTO eval.reference_set(project_id,release_id,source_run_id,label,split,guideline,sampling)
 VALUES(p_project,source_release,p_run,p_label,p_split,p_guideline,metadata) RETURNING id INTO result;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  SELECT unit->'frame'||jsonb_build_object('source_views',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) ORDER BY v.id)) INTO frozen_frame
  FROM kb.source_view v WHERE v.id IN (
   SELECT (unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin'->>'source_view_id')::bigint UNION ALL
   SELECT (pin->>'source_view_id')::bigint FROM jsonb_array_elements(unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'related_pins') pin);
  INSERT INTO eval.reference_unit(set_id,source_view_id,projection_digest,unit_key,context)
  SELECT result,v.id,v.projection_digest,unit->>'unit_key',jsonb_build_array(frozen_frame) FROM kb.source_view v
  WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(membership_snapshot) m WHERE (m->>'source_view_id')::bigint=v.id)
  RETURNING id INTO STRICT unit_id;
  PERFORM eval.validate_operation_reference_frame(unit_id,jsonb_build_object(
   'protocol','source-operation-reference-1','release_id',source_release,'unit_ref',unit->>'unit_key',
   'guideline',p_guideline,'rubric_version',frozen_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'rubric_version',
   'context_policy',frozen_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'context_policy','reason','source-only frame freeze','cases','[]'::jsonb)||
   ((frozen_frame->'evaluation_frame')-ARRAY['unit','release_id','guideline_version','pin','anchor_ids','related_pins','anchor_scopes','contribution_ids','source_group','partition','inspected_scope','opportunities','exposure_history']),frozen_frame);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN result;
END

  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_sampling->>'cohort',''))='' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample requires frozen guideline, partition, seed, strata, inclusion and provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_units)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT u->>'unit_key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'))<>jsonb_array_length(p_units) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record sample repeats or omits eligible unit probabilities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.source_view v JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id
   JOIN eval.document_split legacy ON legacy.project_id=p_project AND legacy.source_uri=d.source_uri AND legacy.split=p_split
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
   JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group
   WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND d.project_id=p_project
    AND origin.partition=p_sampling->>'partition')
   OR jsonb_typeof(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->(unit->>'unit_key')) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR NOT(0<(p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric
    AND (p_sampling->'inclusion_probabilities'->>(unit->>'unit_key'))::numeric<=1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'sample unit is outside immutable origin partition/legacy split or lacks inclusion probability' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(groups) ORDER BY groups.origin_group) INTO group_snapshot FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT origin.* FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
  JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
  JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group) groups;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(u||jsonb_build_object('origin_group',member.origin_group,'source_uri',d.source_uri) ORDER BY u->>'unit_key')
 INTO unit_snapshot FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) u JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(u->>'source_view_id')::bigint
 JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=p_project AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(member) ORDER BY source_view_id) INTO membership_snapshot FROM ops.run_source_view member WHERE run_id=p_run;
 metadata:=p_sampling||jsonb_build_object('origin_groups',group_snapshot,'eligible_units',unit_snapshot,
  'source_cut_id',source_cut,'source_membership',membership_snapshot,'membership_snapshot_kind','reference_set_creation');
 INSERT INTO eval.reference_set(project_id,release_id,source_run_id,label,split,guideline,sampling)
 VALUES(p_project,source_release,p_run,p_label,p_split,p_guideline,metadata) RETURNING id INTO result;
 FOR unit IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_units) LOOP
  SELECT unit->'frame'||jsonb_build_object('source_views',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) ORDER BY v.id)) INTO frozen_frame
  FROM kb.source_view v WHERE v.id IN (
   SELECT (unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'pin'->>'source_view_id')::bigint UNION ALL
   SELECT (pin->>'source_view_id')::bigint FROM jsonb_array_elements(unit->'frame'->'evaluation_frame'->'related_pins') pin);
  INSERT INTO eval.reference_unit(set_id,source_view_id,projection_digest,unit_key,context)
  SELECT result,v.id,v.projection_digest,unit->>'unit_key',jsonb_build_array(frozen_frame) FROM kb.source_view v
  WHERE v.id=(unit->>'source_view_id')::bigint AND v.key=unit->>'unit_key' AND EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(membership_snapshot) m WHERE (m->>'source_view_id')::bigint=v.id)
  RETURNING id INTO STRICT unit_id;
  PERFORM eval.validate_operation_reference_frame(unit_id,jsonb_build_object(
   'protocol','source-operation-reference-1','release_id',source_release,'unit_ref',unit->>'unit_key',
   'guideline',p_guideline,'rubric_version',frozen_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'rubric_version',
   'context_policy',frozen_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'context_policy','reason','source-only frame freeze','cases','[]'::jsonb)||
   ((frozen_frame->'evaluation_frame')-ARRAY['unit','release_id','guideline_version','pin','anchor_ids','related_pins','anchor_scopes','contribution_ids','source_group','partition','inspected_scope','opportunities','exposure_history']),frozen_frame);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN result;
END $$

catalog.arguments: p_unit bigint, p_payload jsonb, p_frame jsonb
catalog.body:
DECLARE unit eval.reference_unit; reference_set eval.reference_set; selected kb.source_view;
 source_record jsonb; pin jsonb; bound jsonb; expected jsonb; related kb.source_view;
 captured jsonb; captured_view kb.source_view; source_snapshot jsonb; scope jsonb; scope_schema json; scope_pointer text; scope_node jsonb; scope_text text; capture_schema json;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT unit FROM eval.reference_unit WHERE id=p_unit;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT reference_set FROM eval.reference_set WHERE id=unit.set_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT selected FROM kb.source_view WHERE id=unit.source_view_id;
 bound:=p_frame->'evaluation_frame';
 IF unit.context IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(p_frame)
  OR COALESCE(p_frame->>'protocol','') NOT IN ('source-operation-frame-1','source-operation-frame-2') OR p_frame-ARRAY['protocol','evaluation_frame','source_views','captured_coordinates','context_dependency_digest']<>'{}'
  OR jsonb_typeof(bound) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR bound-ARRAY['unit','release_id','guideline_version','rubric_version','context_policy','pin','anchor_ids','related_pins','anchor_scopes','operation_question','operation_version','domain','direction','contribution_ids','source_group','partition','inspected_scope','opportunities','exposure_history']<>'{}'
  OR p_payload->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-operation-reference-1'
  OR p_payload-ARRAY['protocol','release_id','unit_ref','guideline','rubric_version','context_policy',
    'operation_question','operation_version','domain','direction','reason','cases','adjudication_passes']<>'{}'
  OR reference_set.sampling->>'operation_protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-operation-reference-1'
  OR btrim(COALESCE(reference_set.sampling->>'guideline_text',''))=''
  OR reference_set.sampling->>'guideline_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(reference_set.sampling->>'guideline_text','UTF8')),'hex')
  OR reference_set.sampling->>'membership_snapshot_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'reference_set_creation'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.input_cut WHERE id=(reference_set.sampling->>'source_cut_id')::bigint
    AND run_id=reference_set.source_run_id AND release_id=reference_set.release_id)
  OR p_payload->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.release_id
  OR p_payload->>'unit_ref' IS DISTINCT FROM unit.unit_key OR bound->>'unit' IS DISTINCT FROM unit.unit_key
  OR bound->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.release_id
  OR p_payload->>'guideline' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.guideline
  OR bound->>'guideline_version' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.guideline
  OR bound->>'rubric_version' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload->>'rubric_version'
  OR bound->>'context_policy' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload->>'context_policy'
  OR unit.projection_digest IS DISTINCT FROM selected.projection_digest
  OR jsonb_typeof(bound->'anchor_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(bound->'related_pins') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(bound->'anchor_scopes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_frame->'source_views') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_frame->'captured_coordinates') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR (p_frame->>'context_dependency_digest' IS NOT NULL AND (p_frame->>'context_dependency_digest') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'reason',''))=''
  OR bound->>'direction' NOT IN ('source_first','output_first')
  OR jsonb_typeof(bound->'contribution_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR (bound->>'direction'='source_first' AND bound->'contribution_ids'<>'[]')
  OR (bound->>'direction'='output_first' AND jsonb_array_length(bound->'contribution_ids')=0)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM unnest(ARRAY['rubric_version','context_policy','operation_question','operation_version','domain','direction']) k
    WHERE btrim(COALESCE(bound->>k,''))='' OR p_payload->>k IS DISTINCT FROM bound->>k) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record reference differs from frozen source/guideline/release protocol' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF bound->>'direction'='output_first' AND EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(bound->'contribution_ids') identity WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM kb.source_contribution contribution JOIN ops.task selected_task
    ON contribution.task_id=COALESCE(selected_task.reused_task_id,selected_task.id)
   JOIN kb.source_contribution_operation operation ON operation.task_id=contribution.task_id
    AND operation.operation_key=contribution.operation_key
   WHERE selected_task.run_id=reference_set.source_run_id AND contribution.source_view_id=unit.source_view_id
    AND contribution.contribution_id=identity AND contribution.release_id=reference_set.release_id
    AND operation.question=bound->>'operation_question' AND operation.operation_version=bound->>'operation_version')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'output-first selection is outside retained operation contribution population' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 expected:=eval.validate_reference_source_scope(p_unit,p_frame);
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'cases') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation cases must be an array' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p_frame->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.sampling->>'source_frame_abi' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation frame ABI differs from frozen set' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF p_frame->>'protocol'='source-operation-frame-1' THEN
  IF bound ?| ARRAY['source_group','partition','inspected_scope','opportunities','exposure_history'] THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy frame cannot contain version two fields' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF bound->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.sampling->>'partition'
   OR btrim(COALESCE(bound->>'source_group',''))='' OR btrim(COALESCE(bound->>'inspected_scope',''))=''
   OR jsonb_typeof(bound->'opportunities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(bound->'opportunities')=0
   OR jsonb_typeof(bound->'exposure_history') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR (bound->>'partition' IN ('final_event_calibration','final_assessment') AND bound->'exposure_history'<>'[]')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(reference_set.sampling->'eligible_units') u
    WHERE u->>'unit_key'=unit.unit_key AND u->>'origin_group'=bound->>'source_group')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(bound->'opportunities') o GROUP BY o->>'opportunity_id' HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation source opportunities differ from frozen group/partition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  FOR source_record IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(bound->'opportunities') LOOP
   IF source_record-ARRAY['opportunity_id','source_view_id','start','end','facet','source_state']<>'{}'
    OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'source_view_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'start') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'end') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR btrim(COALESCE(source_record->>'opportunity_id',''))='' OR btrim(COALESCE(source_record->>'facet',''))=''
    OR COALESCE(source_record->>'source_state','') NOT IN ('stated','unstated','inapplicable','unresolved','uninspected')
    OR COALESCE(source_record->>'start','') !~ '^[0-9]+$' OR COALESCE(source_record->>'end','') !~ '^[0-9]+$'
    OR (source_record->>'end')::bigint <= (source_record->>'start')::bigint
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'source_views') v WHERE v->>'id'=source_record->>'source_view_id'
     AND (source_record->>'end')::bigint<=length(v->'projection'->>'text')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid independent source opportunity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 FOR source_record IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'cases') LOOP
  IF source_record-ARRAY['case_id','facet','anchor_ids','inspected_scope','source_state','judgment','alternatives','explanation',
    'assessor_provenance','contribution_kind','contribution_id','error_category','candidate_selector','permissible_anchor_sets','expectation_mode','anchor_endpoint_role']<>'{}'
   OR NOT(source_record ?& ARRAY['case_id','facet','anchor_ids','inspected_scope','source_state','judgment','alternatives','explanation','assessor_provenance'])
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM unnest(ARRAY['case_id','facet','inspected_scope','explanation']) k WHERE btrim(COALESCE(source_record->>k,''))='')
   OR COALESCE(source_record->>'judgment','') NOT IN ('supported','unsupported','ambiguous','unassessed')
   OR COALESCE(source_record->>'source_state','') NOT IN ('stated','unstated','uninspected','unresolved')
   OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'anchor_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'alternatives') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'assessor_provenance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR source_record->'assessor_provenance'='{}'
   OR (source_record ? 'candidate_selector' AND jsonb_typeof(source_record->'candidate_selector') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object')
   OR COALESCE(source_record->>'expectation_mode','structure') NOT IN ('structure','absence_detection')
   OR (source_record->>'anchor_endpoint_role' IS NOT NULL AND (
    COALESCE(source_record->>'contribution_kind','proposal') NOT IN ('proposal','relation')
    OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'anchor_endpoint_role')<>'string'
    OR btrim(source_record->>'anchor_endpoint_role')=''))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'alternatives') a WHERE jsonb_typeof(a)<>'object' OR a='{}')
   OR (source_record->>'source_state'='uninspected' AND source_record->>'judgment'<>'unassessed')
   OR (source_record->>'source_state'='stated' AND source_record->>'judgment'='supported' AND source_record->'alternatives'='[]')
   OR NOT((bound->'anchor_ids') @> (source_record->'anchor_ids'))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'alternatives') expected_option
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(expected_option->'endpoint_semantics','[]')) endpoint
    WHERE endpoint-ARRAY['role','anchor_ids','fields']<>'{}' OR btrim(COALESCE(endpoint->>'role',''))=''
     OR jsonb_typeof(endpoint->'anchor_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
     OR jsonb_typeof(endpoint->'fields') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR NOT((bound->'anchor_ids') @> (endpoint->'anchor_ids')))
   OR (source_record ? 'permissible_anchor_sets' AND (jsonb_typeof(source_record->'permissible_anchor_sets') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
     OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'permissible_anchor_sets') permitted
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(permitted)<>'array' OR NOT((bound->'anchor_ids') @> permitted))))
   OR (bound->>'direction'='source_first' AND source_record->>'contribution_id' IS NOT NULL)
   OR (bound->>'direction'='output_first' AND (source_record->>'contribution_id' IS NULL OR NOT(bound->'contribution_ids' ? (source_record->>'contribution_id')))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation case differs from independent source/facet authority' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_payload->'cases')<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT r->>'case_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'cases') r) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation reference duplicates case identities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

   OR COALESCE(source_record->>'source_state','') NOT IN ('stated','unstated','uninspected','unresolved')
   OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'anchor_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'alternatives') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'assessor_provenance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR source_record->'assessor_provenance'='{}'
   OR (source_record ? 'candidate_selector' AND jsonb_typeof(source_record->'candidate_selector') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object')
   OR COALESCE(source_record->>'expectation_mode','structure') NOT IN ('structure','absence_detection')
   OR (source_record->>'anchor_endpoint_role' IS NOT NULL AND (
    COALESCE(source_record->>'contribution_kind','proposal') NOT IN ('proposal','relation')
    OR jsonb_typeof(source_record->'anchor_endpoint_role')<>'string'
    OR btrim(source_record->>'anchor_endpoint_role')=''))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'alternatives') a WHERE jsonb_typeof(a)<>'object' OR a='{}')
   OR (source_record->>'source_state'='uninspected' AND source_record->>'judgment'<>'unassessed')
   OR (source_record->>'source_state'='stated' AND source_record->>'judgment'='supported' AND source_record->'alternatives'='[]')
   OR NOT((bound->'anchor_ids') @> (source_record->'anchor_ids'))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'alternatives') expected_option
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(expected_option->'endpoint_semantics','[]')) endpoint
    WHERE endpoint-ARRAY['role','anchor_ids','fields']<>'{}' OR btrim(COALESCE(endpoint->>'role',''))=''
     OR jsonb_typeof(endpoint->'anchor_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
     OR jsonb_typeof(endpoint->'fields') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR NOT((bound->'anchor_ids') @> (endpoint->'anchor_ids')))
   OR (source_record ? 'permissible_anchor_sets' AND (jsonb_typeof(source_record->'permissible_anchor_sets') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
     OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_record->'permissible_anchor_sets') permitted
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(permitted)<>'array' OR NOT((bound->'anchor_ids') @> permitted))))
   OR (bound->>'direction'='source_first' AND source_record->>'contribution_id' IS NOT NULL)
   OR (bound->>'direction'='output_first' AND (source_record->>'contribution_id' IS NULL OR NOT(bound->'contribution_ids' ? (source_record->>'contribution_id')))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation case differs from independent source/facet authority' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_payload->'cases')<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT r->>'case_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'cases') r) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation reference duplicates case identities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $$

  JOIN ops.input_cut cut ON cut.id=c.cut_id AND cut.run_id=r.id AND cut.release_id=c.release_id
  WHERE c.run_id=p_run AND r.project_id=p_project AND r.sealed AND r.status='finished' AND cut.final;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(completed.release_id,'reference_operation_grade');
 IF reference_set.sampling->>'operation_protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-operation-reference-1'
  OR completed.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.release_id
  OR p_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM eval.native_reference_snapshot(p_set)
  OR jsonb_array_length(p_snapshot)=0
  OR jsonb_array_length(p_snapshot)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM eval.reference_unit WHERE set_id=p_set)
  OR p_result->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'source-operation-evaluation-1'
  OR p_result->>'release_id' IS DISTINCT FROM completed.release_id
  OR (p_result->>'set_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM p_set
  OR (p_result->>'run_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM p_run
  OR p_result->'reference_snapshot' IS DISTINCT FROM p_snapshot
  OR p_result->>'partition' IS DISTINCT FROM reference_set.sampling->>'partition'
  OR p_result->>'quality_claim' IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_established'
  OR p_result->>'population_claim' IS DISTINCT FROM 'declared_cases_only'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_result->'units') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(p_result->'units')<>jsonb_array_length(p_snapshot) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation evaluation source/release/snapshot differs or is stale' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR snap IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_snapshot) LOOP
  SELECT * INTO STRICT unit FROM eval.reference_unit WHERE id=(snap->>'unit_id')::bigint AND set_id=p_set;
  SELECT f.source_frame,convert_from(p.authored,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO STRICT source_frame,authored
   FROM eval.reference_pass p JOIN eval.reference_frame f ON f.pass_id=p.id
   WHERE p.id=(snap->>'pass_id')::bigint AND f.id=(snap->>'frame_id')::bigint

  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.run_source_view v WHERE v.run_id=p_run AND v.source_view_id=unit.source_view_id)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'units') assessed
    WHERE (assessed->>'unit_id')::bigint=unit.id AND (assessed->>'source_view_id')::bigint=unit.source_view_id
     AND assessed->>'direction'=source_frame->'evaluation_frame'->>'direction'
     AND jsonb_array_length(assessed->'cases')=jsonb_array_length(authored->'cases')
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(authored->'cases') expected WHERE NOT EXISTS(
       SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(assessed->'cases') actual WHERE actual->>'case_id'=expected->>'case_id'
        AND actual->>'facet'=expected->>'facet' AND actual->>'judgment' IN ('supported','unsupported','ambiguous','unassessed')))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation evaluation misses selected source cases or changes their grain' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
END

catalog.body:
DECLARE actual jsonb; result_id bigint; frame_digest text; parameters jsonb; item jsonb; n integer;
BEGIN
 actual:=eval.operation_event_fit_frame(p_project,p_evaluation);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation fitting source/frame/C snapshot is stale or forged' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 frame_digest:=encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(ops.contextual_identity_value(p_frame->'frame')),'UTF8')),'hex');
 IF p_result->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'operation-event-fit-result-1'
  OR p_result->>'assessment_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'in_sample_development'
  OR p_result->>'origin_requirement' IS DISTINCT FROM 'none'
  OR p_result->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM frame_digest
  OR COALESCE(p_result->>'status','') NOT IN ('fitted','unavailable','failed')
  OR (p_result->>'observations')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'frame'->'observations')
  OR (p_result->>'positive')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'frame'->'observations') o WHERE o->>'judgment'='supported')
  OR (p_result->>'negative')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'frame'->'observations') o WHERE o->>'judgment'='unsupported')
  OR (p_result->>'labeled')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM (p_result->>'positive')::integer+(p_result->>'negative')::integer THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation fit result changes the declared event/label population' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 parameters:=p_result->'parameters';
 IF p_result->>'status'='fitted' THEN
  IF (p_result->>'positive')::integer<1 OR (p_result->>'negative')::integer<1
   OR parameters->>'event' IS DISTINCT FROM 'defined_by_correctness'
   OR parameters->>'assessment_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'in_sample_development'
   OR parameters->>'frame_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM frame_digest
   OR parameters->>'producer_version' IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->>'producer_version'
   OR parameters->>'event_version' IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->>'event_version'
   OR parameters->>'corpus_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->>'corpus_id'
   OR parameters->>'rubric_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->>'rubric_digest'
   OR parameters->>'reference_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->>'reference_digest'
   OR parameters->'feature_names' IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->'feature_names'
   OR parameters-ARRAY['algorithm','event','event_version','producer_version','feature_names','frame_digest','corpus_id','rubric_digest','reference_digest','assessment_mode','means','scales','coefficients','intercept']<>'{}'
   OR NOT (parameters->'algorithm' ?& ARRAY['algorithm','solver','weights','regularization_c','tolerance','max_iterations'])
   OR (parameters->'algorithm')-ARRAY['algorithm','solver','weights','regularization_c','tolerance','max_iterations']<>'{}'
   OR parameters->'algorithm'->>'algorithm' IS DISTINCT FROM 'scaled-logistic-operation-event-1'
   OR parameters->'algorithm'->>'solver' IS DISTINCT FROM 'lbfgs'
   OR parameters->'algorithm'->>'weights' IS DISTINCT FROM 'unit'
   OR jsonb_typeof(parameters->'algorithm'->'regularization_c') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR jsonb_typeof(parameters->'algorithm'->'tolerance') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR jsonb_typeof(parameters->'algorithm'->'max_iterations') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR COALESCE(parameters->'algorithm'->>'max_iterations','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
   OR (parameters->'algorithm'->>'regularization_c')::numeric<=0
   OR (parameters->'algorithm'->>'regularization_c')::numeric>1.7976931348623157e308
   OR (parameters->'algorithm'->>'tolerance')::numeric<=0
   OR (parameters->'algorithm'->>'tolerance')::numeric>1.7976931348623157e308
   OR (parameters->'algorithm'->>'max_iterations')::integer<1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'fitted parameters lack exact event applicability or finite algorithm' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  n:=jsonb_array_length(parameters->'feature_names');
  IF jsonb_array_length(parameters->'means') IS DISTINCT FROM n OR jsonb_array_length(parameters->'scales') IS DISTINCT FROM n
   OR jsonb_array_length(parameters->'coefficients') IS DISTINCT FROM n OR jsonb_typeof(parameters->'intercept') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR abs((parameters->>'intercept')::numeric)>1.7976931348623157e308
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(parameters->'scales') s WHERE jsonb_typeof(s)<>'number' OR (s#>>'{}')::numeric<=0 OR (s#>>'{}')::numeric>1.7976931348623157e308)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements((parameters->'means')||(parameters->'coefficients')) s WHERE jsonb_typeof(s)<>'number' OR abs((s#>>'{}')::numeric)>1.7976931348623157e308) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation fitted parameters must be finite and shape-complete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF parameters IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'failed/unavailable fitting cannot yield runtime parameters' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_result->'predictions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR (p_result->>'status'='fitted' AND jsonb_array_length(p_result->'predictions')<>jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'frame'->'event_ids')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'fitted event predictions require their complete declared population' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_result->'predictions')>0 THEN
  IF (SELECT jsonb_agg(x->>'event_id' ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'predictions') WITH ORDINALITY AS q(x,ord)) IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->'event_ids'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'predictions') x JOIN jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'frame'->'observations') o ON x->>'event_id'=o->>'event_id' WHERE x->>'judgment' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'judgment') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation predictions change exact event/label identity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'predictions') LOOP
   IF NOT item ?& ARRAY['event_id','judgment','prior_probability','fitted_probability']
    OR item-ARRAY['event_id','judgment','prior_probability','fitted_probability']<>'{}'
    OR jsonb_typeof(item->'prior_probability') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR NOT (0<=(item->>'prior_probability')::numeric AND (item->>'prior_probability')::numeric<=1)
    OR (p_result->>'status'='fitted' AND (
     jsonb_typeof(item->'fitted_probability') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
     OR NOT (0<=(item->>'fitted_probability')::numeric AND (item->>'fitted_probability')::numeric<=1)))
    OR (p_result->>'status'<>'fitted' AND item->'fitted_probability' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation predictions require finite status-qualified probabilities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO eval.operation_event_fit(project_id,evaluation_id,run_id,cut_id,release_id,set_id,source_frame_digest,reference_snapshot,frame,result,content_digest)
 VALUES(p_project,p_evaluation,(p_frame->>'run_id')::bigint,(p_frame->>'cut_id')::bigint,p_frame->>'release_id',(p_frame->>'set_id')::bigint,
 p_frame->>'source_frame_digest',p_frame->'reference_snapshot',p_frame,p_result,
 encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_object('frame',p_frame,'result',p_result)),'UTF8')),'hex')) RETURNING id INTO result_id;
 RETURN result_id;
END

   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(parameters->'scales') s WHERE jsonb_typeof(s)<>'number' OR (s#>>'{}')::numeric<=0 OR (s#>>'{}')::numeric>1.7976931348623157e308)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements((parameters->'means')||(parameters->'coefficients')) s WHERE jsonb_typeof(s)<>'number' OR abs((s#>>'{}')::numeric)>1.7976931348623157e308) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation fitted parameters must be finite and shape-complete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSIF parameters IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'failed/unavailable fitting cannot yield runtime parameters' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_result->'predictions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR (p_result->>'status'='fitted' AND jsonb_array_length(p_result->'predictions')<>jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'frame'->'event_ids')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'fitted event predictions require their complete declared population' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_result->'predictions')>0 THEN
  IF (SELECT jsonb_agg(x->>'event_id' ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'predictions') WITH ORDINALITY AS q(x,ord)) IS DISTINCT FROM p_frame->'frame'->'event_ids'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'predictions') x JOIN jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'frame'->'observations') o ON x->>'event_id'=o->>'event_id' WHERE x->>'judgment' IS DISTINCT FROM o->>'judgment') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation predictions change exact event/label identity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->'predictions') LOOP
   IF NOT item ?& ARRAY['event_id','judgment','prior_probability','fitted_probability']
    OR item-ARRAY['event_id','judgment','prior_probability','fitted_probability']<>'{}'
    OR jsonb_typeof(item->'prior_probability') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR NOT (0<=(item->>'prior_probability')::numeric AND (item->>'prior_probability')::numeric<=1)
    OR (p_result->>'status'='fitted' AND (
     jsonb_typeof(item->'fitted_probability') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
     OR NOT (0<=(item->>'fitted_probability')::numeric AND (item->>'fitted_probability')::numeric<=1)))
    OR (p_result->>'status'<>'fitted' AND item->'fitted_probability' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'operation predictions require finite status-qualified probabilities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO eval.operation_event_fit(project_id,evaluation_id,run_id,cut_id,release_id,set_id,source_frame_digest,reference_snapshot,frame,result,content_digest)
 VALUES(p_project,p_evaluation,(p_frame->>'run_id')::bigint,(p_frame->>'cut_id')::bigint,p_frame->>'release_id',(p_frame->>'set_id')::bigint,
 p_frame->>'source_frame_digest',p_frame->'reference_snapshot',p_frame,p_result,
 encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_object('frame',p_frame,'result',p_result)),'UTF8')),'hex')) RETURNING id INTO result_id;
 RETURN result_id;
END $$

  OR COALESCE(p_frame->>'partition','') NOT IN ('development','feature_fit','final_event_calibration','final_assessment')
  OR COALESCE(p_frame->>'operation','') NOT IN ('definition_components','definition_applicability','scoped_relationship','qualified_comparison','dossier')
  OR COALESCE(p_frame->>'direction','') NOT IN ('source_first','output_first')
  OR btrim(COALESCE(p_frame->>'rubric_version',''))='' OR btrim(COALESCE(p_frame->>'rubric_text',''))=''
  OR jsonb_typeof(p_frame->'product_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'product_ids') v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v)<>'string' OR btrim(v#>>'{}')='')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'product_ids') v GROUP BY v HAVING count(*)>1)
  OR (p_frame->>'direction'='source_first' AND jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'product_ids')<>0)
  OR (p_frame->>'direction'='output_first' AND jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'product_ids')=0) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid independent structural frame' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_frame->'source_groups') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'source_groups')<>jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'inputs'->'sources')
   OR jsonb_typeof(p_frame->'opportunities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_frame->'opportunities')=0
   OR btrim(COALESCE(p_frame->>'inspected_scope',''))='' OR jsonb_typeof(p_frame->'exposure_history') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR (p_frame->>'partition' IN ('final_event_calibration','final_assessment') AND p_frame->'exposure_history'<>'[]')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'source_groups') g GROUP BY g->>'source_ref' HAVING count(*)>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'opportunities') o GROUP BY o->>'opportunity_id' HAVING count(*)>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'source_groups') g WHERE g-ARRAY['source_ref','origin_group']<>'{}'
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'inputs'->'sources') src
     JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=(src->>'source_view_id')::bigint JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id
     JOIN eval.reference_origin_source member ON member.project_id=d.project_id AND member.source_uri=d.source_uri
     JOIN eval.reference_origin_group origin ON origin.project_id=member.project_id AND origin.origin_group=member.origin_group
     WHERE encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(src),'UTF8')),'hex')=g->>'source_ref'
      AND g->>'origin_group'=origin.origin_group AND origin.partition=p_frame->>'partition'))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'opportunities') o WHERE o-ARRAY['opportunity_id','passage_id','facet','source_state']<>'{}'
    OR btrim(COALESCE(o->>'opportunity_id',''))='' OR btrim(COALESCE(o->>'facet',''))=''
    OR COALESCE(o->>'source_state','') NOT IN ('stated','unstated','inapplicable','unresolved','uninspected')
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_frame->'inputs'->'passages') p WHERE p->>'passage_id'=o->>'passage_id')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid structural source opportunity/group/partition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM ops.validate_structural_input(p_frame->'inputs');
 INSERT INTO eval.structural_reference_set(project_id,release_id,frame,frame_digest)
 VALUES(p_project,p_release,p_frame,encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(p_frame),'UTF8')),'hex')) RETURNING id INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END

RETURNS SETOF text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT root
 UNION ALL
 SELECT candidate.key FROM jsonb_each(row_map) candidate
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT row_map->(row_map->root->'component'->>'frame')->'component' AS frame) host
 WHERE row_map->root->'component'->>'kind'='predicate_reading'
  AND (
   (candidate.value->'component'->>'kind'='predicate_qualifier'
    AND candidate.value->'component'->>'host_contribution_id'=row_map->root->'component'->>'frame')
   OR
   (candidate.value->'component'->>'kind'='predicate_cue'
    AND candidate.value->'component'->>'host_state'='unresolved'
    AND candidate.value->'component'->>'scope'=host.frame->>'scope'
    AND candidate.value->'component'->>'annotation'=host.frame->>'annotation'
    AND candidate.value->'component'->'candidate_tokens' @> jsonb_build_array(host.frame->'predicate_token'))
  )
$$

   AND endpoint->>'role'='target'

$$

catalog.body:
WITH extents_ AS (
  SELECT (e->>'start')::bigint AS a,(e->>'end')::bigint AS b,n,
   lag((e->>'end')::bigint) OVER(ORDER BY n) AS previous_end
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(extents) WITH ORDINALITY x(e,n)
 ), pieces AS (
  SELECT p,(p->>'start')::bigint AS a,(p->>'end')::bigint AS b,n
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(projection->'pieces') WITH ORDINALITY x(p,n)
 ), selected_tokens AS (
  SELECT (t->>'start')::bigint AS a,(t->>'end')::bigint AS b,n-1 AS i
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(tokens) WITH ORDINALITY x(t,n)
  WHERE indices @> jsonb_build_array(n-1)
 ), token_runs AS (
  SELECT e.n,t.a,t.b,lag(t.b) OVER(PARTITION BY e.n ORDER BY t.i) AS previous_end
  FROM extents_ e JOIN selected_tokens t ON e.a<=t.a AND t.b<=e.b
 ), physical AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
   p.p->>'item_ref'||CASE WHEN p.p->>'source_field'='cell_text'
    THEN '/data/table_cells/'||(p.p->>'cell_index') ELSE '' END,
   greatest(e.a,p.a)-p.a,least(e.b,p.b)-p.a
  ) ORDER BY e.n,p.n) AS anchors
  FROM extents_ e JOIN pieces p ON p.a<e.b AND p.b>e.a AND p.p->>'kind'='native_text'
 )
 SELECT jsonb_array_length(extents)>0 AND jsonb_array_length(indices)>0
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM extents_ e WHERE e.a<lo OR e.b>hi OR e.a>=e.b OR e.previous_end>e.a)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM extents_ e JOIN pieces p ON p.a<e.b AND p.b>e.a
  WHERE p.p->>'kind'<>'native_text' OR coalesce(p.p->>'source_field','text') NOT IN ('text','orig','cell_text'))
 AND (SELECT jsonb_agg(i ORDER BY i) FROM selected_tokens) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM indices
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_tokens)=(SELECT count(*) FROM token_runs)
 AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM extents_ e LEFT JOIN token_runs t USING(n)
  GROUP BY e.n,e.a,e.b HAVING min(t.a) IS DISTINCT FROM e.a OR max(t.b) IS DISTINCT FROM e.b
 )
 AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM token_runs r WHERE r.previous_end IS NOT NULL AND
   substring(projection->>'text' FROM (r.previous_end+1)::integer FOR (r.a-r.previous_end)::integer)
    ~ '[^[:space:]]'
 )
 AND (SELECT physical.anchors FROM physical) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a->>'pointer',a->'start',a->'end') ORDER BY n)
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(anchors) WITH ORDINALITY x(a,n)
  WHERE a->>'space'='native' AND a->>'precision'='exact'
 );

  FROM jsonb_array_elements(extents) WITH ORDINALITY x(e,n)
 ), pieces AS (
  SELECT p,(p->>'start')::bigint AS a,(p->>'end')::bigint AS b,n
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(projection->'pieces') WITH ORDINALITY x(p,n)
 ), selected_tokens AS (
  SELECT (t->>'start')::bigint AS a,(t->>'end')::bigint AS b,n-1 AS i
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(tokens) WITH ORDINALITY x(t,n)
  WHERE indices @> jsonb_build_array(n-1)
 ), token_runs AS (
  SELECT e.n,t.a,t.b,lag(t.b) OVER(PARTITION BY e.n ORDER BY t.i) AS previous_end
  FROM extents_ e JOIN selected_tokens t ON e.a<=t.a AND t.b<=e.b
 ), physical AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
   p.p->>'item_ref'||CASE WHEN p.p->>'source_field'='cell_text'
    THEN '/data/table_cells/'||(p.p->>'cell_index') ELSE '' END,
   greatest(e.a,p.a)-p.a,least(e.b,p.b)-p.a
  ) ORDER BY e.n,p.n) AS anchors
  FROM extents_ e JOIN pieces p ON p.a<e.b AND p.b>e.a AND p.p->>'kind'='native_text'
 )
 SELECT jsonb_array_length(extents)>0 AND jsonb_array_length(indices)>0
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM extents_ e WHERE e.a<lo OR e.b>hi OR e.a>=e.b OR e.previous_end>e.a)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM extents_ e JOIN pieces p ON p.a<e.b AND p.b>e.a
  WHERE p.p->>'kind'<>'native_text' OR coalesce(p.p->>'source_field','text') NOT IN ('text','orig','cell_text'))
 AND (SELECT jsonb_agg(i ORDER BY i) FROM selected_tokens) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM indices
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_tokens)=(SELECT count(*) FROM token_runs)
 AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM extents_ e LEFT JOIN token_runs t USING(n)
  GROUP BY e.n,e.a,e.b HAVING min(t.a) IS DISTINCT FROM e.a OR max(t.b) IS DISTINCT FROM e.b
 )
 AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM token_runs r WHERE r.previous_end IS NOT NULL AND
   substring(projection->>'text' FROM (r.previous_end+1)::integer FOR (r.a-r.previous_end)::integer)
    ~ '[^[:space:]]'
 )
 AND (SELECT physical.anchors FROM physical) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a->>'pointer',a->'start',a->'end') ORDER BY n)
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(anchors) WITH ORDINALITY x(a,n)
  WHERE a->>'space'='native' AND a->>'precision'='exact'
 );
$$

  a->>'pointer',a->>'space',a->>'precision',(a->>'start')::bigint,(a->>'end')::bigint

 INSERT INTO kb.contextual_profile(task_id,profile_id,dimension,detail)
 SELECT p_task,p->>'profile_id',(p->>'dimension')::integer,p
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'contribution_operations') o,
 LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(o->'contextual_enrichment'->'profiles') p;
 INSERT INTO kb.contextual_vector(task_id,vector_id,object_id,source_binding,profile_id,input_digest,vector)
 SELECT p_task,v->>'vector_id',v->>'object_id',v->>'source_binding',v->>'profile_id',
  v->>'input_digest',(v->'values')::text::public.vector
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'contribution_operations') o,
 LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(o->'contextual_enrichment'->'vectors') v;
 INSERT INTO kb.contextual_inventory(task_id,inventory_id,detail)
 SELECT p_task,i->>'inventory_id',i
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'contribution_operations') o,
 LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(o->'contextual_enrichment'->'inventories') i;
 INSERT INTO kb.contextual_target_vector(task_id,inventory_id,profile_id,target_id,vector_id,search_text,exact_forms,vector)
 SELECT p_task,i->>'inventory_id',v->>'profile_id',target->>'target_id',v->>'vector_id',
  concat_ws(' ',target->>'label',target->>'description',(SELECT string_agg(x,' ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(target->'aliases') x)),
  ARRAY(SELECT lower(x) FROM (SELECT target->>'label' AS x UNION ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(target->'aliases')) forms),
  (v->'values')::text::public.vector
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_envelope->'contribution_operations') o,
 LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(o->'contextual_enrichment'->'inventories') i,
 LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(i->'targets') target,
 LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(o->'contextual_enrichment'->'vectors') v
 WHERE v->>'object_id'=target->>'target_id';
END

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION data.validate_record_admission_overlay(text,text) FROM PUBLIC

catalog.arguments: r text, z text, p_cut bigint
catalog.body:
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE item record; rec jsonb; field jsonb; a data.record_assertion; f data.fact;
 o data.occurrence; e data.evidence; support data.record_assertion_support;
 expected_reading text; expected_occurrence text; expected_evidence text; expected_locator jsonb;
 expected_class text; value_json jsonb; complete boolean; ownset jsonb; anchor jsonb;
 expected_count bigint; actual_count bigint;
BEGIN
 FOR item IN
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (rec->>'record_id',rec->>'interpretation_id') rec,t.id AS origin_task_id,
   doc.source_uri,m.name AS provider,m.version AS operation_version
  FROM ops.cut_task ct JOIN ops.task selected ON selected.id=ct.task_id
  JOIN ops.task t ON t.id=ct.origin_task_id JOIN ops.task_result result ON result.task_id=t.id
  JOIN ops.method_config mc ON mc.id=t.method_config_id JOIN ops.method m ON m.id=mc.method_id
  LEFT JOIN kb.source_view view ON t.unit_type='source_view' AND view.id=t.unit_id
  LEFT JOIN kb.document doc ON doc.id=view.document_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(result.body->'records','[]')) rec
  WHERE ct.cut_id=p_cut AND selected.status IN ('done','empty','reused')
  ORDER BY rec->>'record_id',rec->>'interpretation_id',selected.id
 LOOP
  rec:=item.rec;
  expected_class:=CASE rec->>'family' WHEN 'definition' THEN 'DefinitionReading'
   WHEN 'assertion' THEN 'QualifiedAssertionReading' WHEN 'measurement' THEN 'MeasurementReading'
   WHEN 'table' THEN 'TableAssertionReading' WHEN 'formula_context' THEN 'FormulaContextReading' END;
  complete:=EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.class_definition WHERE release_id=r AND name=expected_class)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(rec->'fields') rf(value) WHERE
    rf.value->>'evidence_status'<>'available' OR jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(rf.value->'evidence_sets','[]'))=0);
  SELECT count(*) INTO actual_count FROM data.record_assertion a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.realization_id=z
   AND (a.record_id,a.interpretation_id)=(rec->>'record_id',rec->>'interpretation_id');
  IF actual_count<>(CASE WHEN complete THEN jsonb_array_length(rec->'fields') ELSE 0 END) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record assertion membership is not the complete released reading' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NOT complete THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
  expected_reading:='source-reading:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(
   jsonb_build_array(r,rec->'record_id',rec->'interpretation_id')),'UTF8')),'hex');
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.membership mem JOIN sem.class_definition cls
   ON cls.release_id=mem.release_id AND cls.class_id=mem.class_id
   WHERE mem.release_id=r AND mem.realization_id=z AND mem.entity_id=expected_reading AND cls.name=expected_class
    AND mem.establishment='stated') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'reading lacks its released source-reading membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  FOR field IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(rec->'fields') LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM data.record_assertion a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.realization_id=z
    AND (a.record_id,a.interpretation_id,a.role)=(rec->>'record_id',rec->>'interpretation_id',field->>'role');
   SELECT * INTO STRICT f FROM data.fact WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z AND fact_id=a.fact_id;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM data.occurrence WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z AND occurrence_id=a.occurrence_id;
   expected_occurrence:='occ:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
    r,z,rec->'pin'->'source',expected_reading||'/'||(field->>'role'))),'UTF8')),'hex');
   value_json:=field-'role'-'evidence_sets'-'alternatives';
   IF (a.reading_id,f.subject_id,f.property_id,o.occurrence_id,o.fact_id,o.source,o.item)
    IS DISTINCT FROM(expected_reading,expected_reading,
     'https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/source-reading/'||expected_class||'/'||(field->>'role'),
     expected_occurrence,a.fact_id,rec->'pin'->>'source',expected_reading||'/'||(field->>'role')) OR
    data.value_meaning(r,z,f.object_value_id) IS DISTINCT FROM data.record_json_meaning(value_json) OR
    data.value_meaning(r,z,f.qualification_value_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
     data.record_json_meaning('{"modality":"asserted","polarity":true}'::jsonb) OR
    (o.report_object_value_id,o.report_qualification_value_id) IS DISTINCT FROM(f.object_value_id,f.qualification_value_id) OR
    NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.support s WHERE s.release_id=r AND s.realization_id=z
     AND s.fact_id=a.fact_id AND s.occurrence_id=a.occurrence_id) OR
    NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_establishment x WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z
     AND x.occurrence_id=a.occurrence_id AND x.establishment='stated') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'record assertion differs from sealed role state and explicit reading qualification' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_context c WHERE c.release_id=r AND c.realization_id=z AND c.occurrence_id=a.occurrence_id) OR
    EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_evidence_role c WHERE c.release_id=r AND c.realization_id=z AND c.occurrence_id=a.occurrence_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source reading invents Agent statement or citation-role context' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   expected_count:=0;
   FOR ownset IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(rec->'evidence_sets') s
    WHERE field->'evidence_sets' ? (s.value->>'set_id') LOOP
    IF ownset->>'role' IS DISTINCT FROM field->>'role' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'reading borrows another role evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    FOR anchor IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(rec->'anchors') an
     WHERE ownset->'anchors' ? (an.value->>'anchor_id') LOOP
     expected_count:=expected_count+1;
     expected_evidence:='reading-evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
      r,item.origin_task_id,rec->'record_id',rec->'interpretation_id',field->'role',ownset->'set_id',anchor->'anchor_id')),'UTF8')),'hex');
     SELECT * INTO STRICT support FROM data.record_assertion_support s WHERE s.release_id=r AND s.realization_id=z
      AND (s.record_id,s.interpretation_id,s.role,s.set_id,s.anchor_id)=
       (a.record_id,a.interpretation_id,a.role,ownset->>'set_id',anchor->>'anchor_id');
     expected_locator:=jsonb_build_object('space',anchor->'space','pointer',anchor->'pointer','precision',anchor->'precision',
      'record_id',rec->'record_id','interpretation_id',rec->'interpretation_id','role',field->'role',
      'set_id',ownset->'set_id','anchor_id',anchor->'anchor_id');
     IF anchor ? 'start' THEN expected_locator:=expected_locator||jsonb_build_object('start',anchor->'start','end',anchor->'end'); END IF;
     SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM data.evidence WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z AND evidence_id=expected_evidence;
     IF (support.origin_task_id,support.evidence_id,support.occurrence_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
       (item.origin_task_id,expected_evidence,a.occurrence_id) OR
      (e.source_uri,e.locator,e.provider,e.operation_version) IS DISTINCT FROM
       (item.source_uri,data.canonical_json(expected_locator),item.provider,item.operation_version) OR
      NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.membership_support ms JOIN sem.class_definition cls
       ON cls.release_id=ms.release_id AND cls.class_id=ms.class_id WHERE ms.release_id=r AND ms.realization_id=z
        AND ms.entity_id=a.reading_id AND cls.name=expected_class AND ms.evidence_id=expected_evidence) OR
      NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_evidence oe WHERE oe.release_id=r AND oe.realization_id=z
       AND oe.occurrence_id=a.occurrence_id AND oe.evidence_id=expected_evidence) OR
      EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.evidence_source es WHERE es.release_id=r AND es.realization_id=z AND es.evidence_id=e.evidence_id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'reading support differs from actual sealed origin field set anchor' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END LOOP;
   END LOOP;
   SELECT count(*) INTO actual_count FROM data.record_assertion_support s WHERE s.release_id=r AND s.realization_id=z
    AND (s.record_id,s.interpretation_id,s.role)=(a.record_id,a.interpretation_id,a.role);
   IF actual_count<>expected_count OR expected_count=0 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM data.occurrence_evidence oe
     WHERE oe.release_id=r AND oe.realization_id=z AND oe.occurrence_id=a.occurrence_id)<>expected_count THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reading support has missing or extra evidence membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion a JOIN data.occurrence extra ON
    extra.release_id=a.release_id AND extra.realization_id=a.realization_id AND extra.fact_id=a.fact_id
   WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.realization_id=z AND extra.occurrence_id<>a.occurrence_id) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion a JOIN data.membership_support ms ON
    ms.release_id=a.release_id AND ms.realization_id=a.realization_id AND ms.entity_id=a.reading_id
   WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.realization_id=z AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion_support support
    WHERE support.release_id=r AND support.realization_id=z AND support.record_id=a.record_id
     AND support.interpretation_id=a.interpretation_id AND support.evidence_id=ms.evidence_id)) OR
  EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.membership mem JOIN sem.class_definition cls ON
    cls.release_id=mem.release_id AND cls.class_id=mem.class_id
   WHERE mem.release_id=r AND mem.realization_id=z AND cls.name IN
    ('DefinitionReading','QualifiedAssertionReading','MeasurementReading','TableAssertionReading','FormulaContextReading')
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.realization_id=z AND a.reading_id=mem.entity_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'reading has extra source occurrence or membership evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 -- Every reading-class fact must be a complete authenticated member. This also
 -- prevents ordinary domain rule success from laundering an unbound field.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.fact f JOIN data.membership m ON
   (m.release_id,m.realization_id,m.entity_id)=(f.release_id,f.realization_id,f.subject_id)
   JOIN sem.class_definition cls ON cls.release_id=m.release_id AND cls.class_id=m.class_id
   WHERE f.release_id=r AND f.realization_id=z AND cls.name IN
    ('DefinitionReading','QualifiedAssertionReading','MeasurementReading','TableAssertionReading','FormulaContextReading')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion a WHERE a.release_id=r AND a.realization_id=z AND a.fact_id=f.fact_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'source-reading fact has no complete sealed record membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END
