DECLARE revision ops.pdf_published_revision;
BEGIN
 IF p_section IS NULL OR p_membership IS DISTINCT FROM 'descendants'
 OR p_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'section-source-context-v1' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid selected source selector/policy' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT revision FROM ops.require_published_companion_pin(
 p_project,p_run,p_release,p_task,p_product,p_digest);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM kb.pdf_record_access a WHERE a.product_id=revision.build_id
 AND a.revision_id=revision.build_id AND a.pointer=p_section
 AND a.label IN ('section','chapter')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected source root is not a published section' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task,p_product,p_digest)
), access AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.* FROM kb.pdf_record_access a JOIN published p
 ON a.product_id=p.build_id AND a.revision_id=p.build_id
 ), subtree(pointer) AS (
 SELECT pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section
 UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer FROM access child JOIN subtree parent
 ON child.parent_pointer=parent.pointer
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM subtree)
 ), ancestors(pointer) AS (
 SELECT parent_pointer FROM access WHERE pointer=p_section AND parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT a.parent_pointer FROM access a JOIN ancestors p ON a.pointer=p.pointer
 WHERE a.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL
 ), contained(record_id) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 JOIN selected a ON a.pointer=n.native_address
 UNION
 SELECT child.record_id FROM contained parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_native n
 ON n.record_id=parent.record_id JOIN published p
 ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT f.value->>'target' AS record_id FROM jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') f
 WHERE f.value->>'kind'='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.record_id FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m
 WHERE m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id
 AND m.parent_id=n.record_id AND m.value_kind='record'
 ) child
 ), selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='native_metadata' AND CASE c.body->>'kind'
 WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN c.body->>'pointer' IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN
 (ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body)
 ->'value'->>'section_pointer') IN
 (SELECT pointer FROM selected UNION SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 ELSE false END
 ), nodes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.* FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id AND (n.record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM contained))
), members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m JOIN published p ON m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id AND m.parent_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM nodes)
), fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT record_id,name,value,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY name COLLATE "C")-1 AS slot
 FROM (
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key AS name,x.value,'scalar'::text AS kind FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) x
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key,x.value,x.value->>'kind' FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') x
 ) f
), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.record_id AS parent_id,f.value->>'target' AS child_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[] AS suffix
 FROM fields f WHERE f.kind='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.parent_id,m.record_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[] FROM members m
 JOIN fields f ON f.record_id=m.parent_id AND f.name=m.field_name WHERE m.value_kind='record'
), walk(record_id,path) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id,ARRAY[a.ordinal]::bigint[]
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.child_id,w.path||e.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.parent_id=w.record_id
), events(path,kind,value,prefix) AS (
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '{' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN ''
 ELSE (CASE WHEN f.slot>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||to_jsonb(f.name)::text||':' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) JOIN fields f USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[],CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN f.value ELSE to_jsonb(f.value->>'stream_id') END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '{' ELSE '[' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,0]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key_stream_id)
 ELSE to_jsonb((CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key)::text||':' ELSE '' END) END,
 CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN m.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(m.stream_id) END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE m.value_kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '}' ELSE ']' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,(SELECT count(*) FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id),0]::bigint[],
 'extension',n.structure_json->'extensions'->'stream_id',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id) THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) WHERE n.structure_json ? 'extensions'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '}' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
),metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM selected_metadata
), metadata_fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT cf.*,c.ordinal AS row_ordinal FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field cf
 JOIN metadata_companions c USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
), metadata_events(ordinal,local_id,phase,field_name,subphase,part_ordinal,event) AS (
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,0,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','row','body',c.body) FROM metadata_companions c
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','field','field',
 to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('field_name',f.field_name,'scalar_kind',f.scalar_kind))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,1,part.ordinal,jsonb_build_object('kind','part','part',to_jsonb(part))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_part part USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,2,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','close') FROM metadata_companions c
),
 companion AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text AS payload
 FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(p_task,p_product,p_digest,
 ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,
 c.body::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='health'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text FROM selected_metadata c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint',e.relation_id||':'||e.ordinal::text,e.ordinal,
 jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,'role',e.role,
 'target_task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'target_product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'target_content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id)::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT c.local_id FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
 p_task,p_product,p_digest,ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 WHERE c.family='relation')
 ), companion_order AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY family COLLATE "C",ordinal,local_id COLLATE "C") AS position
 FROM companion
 ), external AS (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('from_pointer',a.pointer,'field',r.field_name,
 'reference_id',r.reference_id,'source_id',r.source_id,'native_address',origin.native_address,
 'source_ordinal',a.ordinal,'source_order',to_jsonb(w.path),
 'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',p_task,'product_key',p_product,'content_digest',p_digest)||
 CASE WHEN r.field_name IN ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id')
 THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_graph_cell','cell_id_lexical',r.native_pointer)
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_item','pointer',r.native_pointer) END,
 'resolution','qualified_external') AS body
 FROM selected a JOIN walk w ON w.path[1]=a.ordinal
 JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON r.source_id=w.record_id
 JOIN nodes origin ON origin.record_id=r.source_id
 JOIN published p ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM nodes target
 WHERE target.record_id=r.target_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,
 'role',e.role,'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id),'resolution','qualified_external')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='relation')
 AND NOT ((e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest) IN
 ((p_task,p_product,p_digest),(0::bigint,'@self','@self'))
 AND e.occurrence_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='occurrence'))
 ), output(phase,path,event) AS (
 SELECT -1,ARRAY[]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','selection_metadata',
 'selected_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),
 'membership_sha256',(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(
 string_agg(pointer||chr(9)||ordinal::text||chr(9)||COALESCE(parent_pointer,'')||chr(10),''
 ORDER BY ordinal),'') ,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM selected))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[a.ordinal,-1]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_start',
 'pointer',a.pointer,'record_id',n.record_id,'ordinal',a.ordinal,'parent_pointer',a.parent_pointer,
 'section_pointer',a.section_pointer,'label',a.label,'role','selected')
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,path,jsonb_build_object('event','native_fragment','native',
 jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'value',value,'prefix',prefix)) FROM events
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[ordinal,3]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_end','pointer',pointer)
 FROM selected
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 1,ARRAY[ordinal]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','ancestor',
 'pointer',pointer,'ordinal',ordinal,'parent_pointer',parent_pointer,'label',label,
 'name',native_json->'name') FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY r.pointer,r.region_index)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','frame','body',to_jsonb(r)-'product_id'-'revision_id')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_region r JOIN published p
 ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,0]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event',
 CASE WHEN family='native_metadata' THEN 'companion_native_start' ELSE 'companion_start' END,
 'family',family,'local_id',local_id,'ordinal',ordinal) FROM companion_order
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,part]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','scalar_part',
 'part',part,'encoding','base64','value',encode(substring(convert_to(c.payload,'UTF8')
 FROM (part*32768+1)::integer FOR 32768),'base64'),'final',
 (part+1)*32768>=octet_length(c.payload)) FROM companion_order c
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(octet_length(c.payload)-1)/32768) part
 WHERE c.family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_end',
 'byte_length',octet_length(payload),'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(payload,'UTF8')),'hex'))
 FROM companion_order WHERE family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.position
 ORDER BY e.phase,e.field_name COLLATE "C",e.subphase,e.part_ordinal)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_fragment','fragment',e.event)
 FROM metadata_events e JOIN companion_order c ON c.family='native_metadata'
 AND c.local_id=e.local_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_end')
 FROM companion_order WHERE family='native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY body::text)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','outside_reference','body',body) FROM external
 ) SELECT event FROM output ORDER BY phase,path;
END

 ), contained(record_id) AS (

 ) child
 ), selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.* FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='native_metadata' AND CASE c.body->>'kind'
 WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN c.body->>'pointer' IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN
 (ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id,c.revision_id,c.family,c.local_id,c.body)
 ->'value'->>'section_pointer') IN
 (SELECT pointer FROM selected UNION SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 ELSE false END
 ), nodes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.* FROM kb.pdf_record_native n JOIN published p ON n.product_id=p.build_id AND n.revision_id=p.build_id AND (n.record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM contained))
), members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.* FROM kb.pdf_record_membership m JOIN published p ON m.product_id=p.build_id AND m.revision_id=p.build_id AND m.parent_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM nodes)
), fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT record_id,name,value,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY name COLLATE "C")-1 AS slot
 FROM (
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key AS name,x.value,'scalar'::text AS kind FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) x
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.record_id,x.key,x.value,x.value->>'kind' FROM nodes n
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json->'fields') x
 ) f
), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.record_id AS parent_id,f.value->>'target' AS child_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[] AS suffix
 FROM fields f WHERE f.kind='object'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.parent_id,m.record_id,ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[] FROM members m
 JOIN fields f ON f.record_id=m.parent_id AND f.name=m.field_name WHERE m.value_kind='record'
), walk(record_id,path) AS (
 SELECT n.record_id,ARRAY[a.ordinal]::bigint[]
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.child_id,w.path||e.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.parent_id=w.record_id
), events(path,kind,value,prefix) AS (
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '{' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN ''
 ELSE (CASE WHEN f.slot>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||to_jsonb(f.name)::text||':' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) JOIN fields f USING(record_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1]::bigint[],CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='scalar' THEN f.value ELSE to_jsonb(f.value->>'stream_id') END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,0]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '{' ELSE '[' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,0]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END,
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key_stream_id)
 ELSE to_jsonb((CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END)||
 CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN to_jsonb(m.member_key)::text||':' ELSE '' END) END,
 CASE WHEN m.ordinal>0 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,1,m.ordinal,1]::bigint[],
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END,
 CASE WHEN m.value_kind='scalar' THEN m.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(m.stream_id) END,''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) JOIN members m ON m.parent_id=f.record_id AND m.field_name=f.name
 WHERE m.value_kind IN ('scalar','parts')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,f.slot,1,2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.kind='map' THEN '}' ELSE ']' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN fields f USING(record_id) WHERE f.kind IN ('array','map')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[1,(SELECT count(*) FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id),0]::bigint[],
 'extension',n.structure_json->'extensions'->'stream_id',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM fields f WHERE f.record_id=n.record_id) THEN ',' ELSE '' END
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id) WHERE n.structure_json ? 'extensions'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.path||ARRAY[2]::bigint[],'literal',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN n.native_type='NativeArray' THEN '' ELSE '}' END),''
 FROM walk w JOIN nodes n USING(record_id)
),metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM selected_metadata
), metadata_fields AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT cf.*,c.ordinal AS row_ordinal FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field cf
 JOIN metadata_companions c USING(product_id,revision_id,family,local_id)
), metadata_events(ordinal,local_id,phase,field_name,subphase,part_ordinal,event) AS (
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,0,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','row','body',c.body) FROM metadata_companions c
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','field','field',
 to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('field_name',f.field_name,'scalar_kind',f.scalar_kind))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream s USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT f.row_ordinal,f.local_id,1,f.field_name,1,part.ordinal,jsonb_build_object('kind','part','part',to_jsonb(part))
 FROM metadata_fields f JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_part part USING(product_id,revision_id,stream_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT c.ordinal,c.local_id,2,''::text,0,0::bigint,jsonb_build_object('kind','close') FROM metadata_companions c
),
 companion AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text AS payload
 FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(p_task,p_product,p_digest,
 ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,
 c.body::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_companion c JOIN published p
 ON c.product_id=p.build_id AND c.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE c.family='health'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.family,c.local_id,c.ordinal,c.body::text FROM selected_metadata c
 UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint',e.relation_id||':'||e.ordinal::text,e.ordinal,
 jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,'role',e.role,
 'target_task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'target_product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'target_content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id)::text
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT c.local_id FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(
 p_task,p_product,p_digest,ARRAY(SELECT pointer FROM selected),p_section) c
 WHERE c.family='relation')
 ), companion_order AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY family COLLATE "C",ordinal,local_id COLLATE "C") AS position
 FROM companion
 ), external AS (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('from_pointer',a.pointer,'field',r.field_name,
 'reference_id',r.reference_id,'source_id',r.source_id,'native_address',origin.native_address,
 'source_ordinal',a.ordinal,'source_order',to_jsonb(w.path),
 'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',p_task,'product_key',p_product,'content_digest',p_digest)||
 CASE WHEN r.field_name IN ('source_cell_id','target_cell_id')
 THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_graph_cell','cell_id_lexical',r.native_pointer)
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space','native_item','pointer',r.native_pointer) END,
 'resolution','qualified_external') AS body
 FROM selected a JOIN walk w ON w.path[1]=a.ordinal
 JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference r ON r.source_id=w.record_id
 JOIN nodes origin ON origin.record_id=r.source_id
 JOIN published p ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM nodes target
 WHERE target.record_id=r.target_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id',e.relation_id,'endpoint_ordinal',e.ordinal,
 'role',e.role,'target',jsonb_build_object('task_id',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0
 THEN p_task ELSE e.target_task_id END,
 'product_key',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_product ELSE e.target_product_key END,
 'content_digest',CASE WHEN e.target_task_id=0 THEN p_digest ELSE e.target_content_digest END,
 'occurrence_id',e.occurrence_id),'resolution','qualified_external')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint e JOIN published p
 ON e.product_id=p.build_id AND e.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE e.relation_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='relation')
 AND NOT ((e.target_task_id,e.target_product_key,e.target_content_digest) IN
 ((p_task,p_product,p_digest),(0::bigint,'@self','@self'))
 AND e.occurrence_id IN (SELECT local_id FROM companion WHERE family='occurrence'))
 ), output(phase,path,event) AS (
 SELECT -1,ARRAY[]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','selection_metadata',
 'selected_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),
 'membership_sha256',(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(
 string_agg(pointer||chr(9)||ordinal::text||chr(9)||COALESCE(parent_pointer,'')||chr(10),''
 ORDER BY ordinal),'') ,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM selected))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[a.ordinal,-1]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_start',
 'pointer',a.pointer,'record_id',n.record_id,'ordinal',a.ordinal,'parent_pointer',a.parent_pointer,
 'section_pointer',a.section_pointer,'label',a.label,'role','selected')
 FROM selected a JOIN nodes n ON n.native_address=a.pointer
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,path,jsonb_build_object('event','native_fragment','native',
 jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'value',value,'prefix',prefix)) FROM events
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 0,ARRAY[ordinal,3]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','record_end','pointer',pointer)
 FROM selected
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 1,ARRAY[ordinal]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','ancestor',
 'pointer',pointer,'ordinal',ordinal,'parent_pointer',parent_pointer,'label',label,
 'name',native_json->'name') FROM access WHERE pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM ancestors)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY r.pointer,r.region_index)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','context','kind','frame','body',to_jsonb(r)-'product_id'-'revision_id')
 FROM kb.pdf_record_region r JOIN published p
 ON r.product_id=p.build_id AND r.revision_id=p.build_id
 WHERE r.pointer IN (SELECT pointer FROM selected)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,0]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event',
 CASE WHEN family='native_metadata' THEN 'companion_native_start' ELSE 'companion_start' END,
 'family',family,'local_id',local_id,'ordinal',ordinal) FROM companion_order
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,part]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','scalar_part',
 'part',part,'encoding','base64','value',encode(substring(convert_to(c.payload,'UTF8')
 FROM (part*32768+1)::integer FOR 32768),'base64'),'final',
 (part+1)*32768>=octet_length(c.payload)) FROM companion_order c
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(octet_length(c.payload)-1)/32768) part
 WHERE c.family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_end',
 'byte_length',octet_length(payload),'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(payload,'UTF8')),'hex'))
 FROM companion_order WHERE family<>'native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[c.position,1,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.position
 ORDER BY e.phase,e.field_name COLLATE "C",e.subphase,e.part_ordinal)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_fragment','fragment',e.event)
 FROM metadata_events e JOIN companion_order c ON c.family='native_metadata'
 AND c.local_id=e.local_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,ARRAY[position,2]::bigint[],jsonb_build_object('event','companion_native_end')
 FROM companion_order WHERE family='native_metadata'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,ARRAY[row_number() OVER(ORDER BY body::text)]::bigint[],
 jsonb_build_object('event','outside_reference','body',body) FROM external
 ) SELECT event FROM output ORDER BY phase,path;
END $selected$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.valid_reuse(t ops.task) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT t.reused_task_id IS NULL OR (
   t.status='reused' AND t.reused_task_id<>t.id AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM ops.task origin JOIN ops.run previous ON previous.id=origin.run_id
    JOIN ops.run current_run ON current_run.id=t.run_id
    JOIN ops.method_config config ON config.id=t.method_config_id
    JOIN ops.method method ON method.id=config.method_id
    WHERE origin.id=t.reused_task_id AND origin.status IN ('done','empty') AND origin.reused_task_id IS NULL
      AND origin.method_config_id=t.method_config_id AND origin.input_hash=t.input_hash
      AND origin.unit_type=t.unit_type AND origin.unit_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.unit_id
      AND origin.unit_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.unit_key AND origin.packet_hash IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.packet_hash
      AND previous.project_id=current_run.project_id AND previous.release_id=current_run.release_id
      AND previous.runtime_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM current_run.runtime_id
      AND previous.input_realization_id=current_run.input_realization_id AND previous.input_revision=current_run.input_revision
      AND ops.task_dependency_scope(convert_from(previous.dependencies,'UTF8')::jsonb,method.name)
        =ops.task_dependency_scope(convert_from(current_run.dependencies,'UTF8')::jsonb,method.name)
   )
 )
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION data.validate_occurrence_context(r text,z text) RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp AS $fn$
DECLARE o data.occurrence; context data.occurrence_context; observation kb.observation;
 edge data.occurrence_evidence; citation_role data.occurrence_evidence_role;
 source data.evidence_source; claim jsonb; statement jsonb; expected_statement text;
 expected_role text; source_rendition_key text; synthesis jsonb; attribute jsonb; attribute_index bigint; attribute_local_id text; establishment text;
BEGIN
 -- SourceReading membership is a released, record-owned source assertion basis.
 -- This check is unconditional: an ordinary append with no record staging must
 -- not evade the record publication gate, including through a released subclass.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.membership membership JOIN sem.class_definition cls
   ON cls.release_id=membership.release_id AND cls.class_id=membership.class_id
   WHERE membership.release_id=r AND membership.realization_id=z AND
    (cls.name='SourceReading' OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.class_hierarchy hierarchy
     JOIN sem.class_definition root ON root.release_id=hierarchy.release_id AND root.class_id=hierarchy.ancestor_id
     WHERE hierarchy.release_id=r AND hierarchy.class_id=cls.class_id AND root.name='SourceReading'))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion assertion JOIN data.source_record record_value ON
     (record_value.release_id,record_value.realization_id,record_value.record_id,record_value.interpretation_id)=
     (assertion.release_id,assertion.realization_id,assertion.record_id,assertion.interpretation_id)
     WHERE assertion.release_id=r AND assertion.realization_id=z AND assertion.reading_id=membership.entity_id
      AND membership.establishment='stated' AND cls.name=CASE record_value.family
       WHEN 'definition' THEN 'DefinitionReading' WHEN 'assertion' THEN 'QualifiedAssertionReading'
       WHEN 'measurement' THEN 'MeasurementReading' WHEN 'table' THEN 'TableAssertionReading'
       WHEN 'formula_context' THEN 'FormulaContextReading' END)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'source-reading membership requires its exact sealed record basis' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.fact fact JOIN data.membership membership ON
    (membership.release_id,membership.realization_id,membership.entity_id)=(fact.release_id,fact.realization_id,fact.subject_id)
   JOIN sem.class_definition cls ON cls.release_id=membership.release_id AND cls.class_id=membership.class_id
   WHERE fact.release_id=r AND fact.realization_id=z AND
    (cls.name='SourceReading' OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.class_hierarchy hierarchy
     JOIN sem.class_definition root ON root.release_id=hierarchy.release_id AND root.class_id=hierarchy.ancestor_id
     WHERE hierarchy.release_id=r AND hierarchy.class_id=cls.class_id AND root.name='SourceReading'))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion assertion WHERE assertion.release_id=r AND assertion.realization_id=z
     AND assertion.fact_id=fact.fact_id AND assertion.reading_id=fact.subject_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'source-reading fact requires complete sealed record membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_establishment e
  WHERE e.release_id=r AND e.realization_id=z
   AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.vocabulary_member v WHERE v.release_id=r AND v.vocabulary_id='Establishment')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.registry_row contract
    WHERE contract.release_id=r AND contract.kind='semantic_contract' AND contract.name='released-semantics-1'
     AND (convert_from(contract.body,'UTF8')::jsonb->'source_establishments') ? e.establishment)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'source establishment is outside released source-admissible subset' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_context c WHERE c.release_id=r AND c.realization_id=z
   AND c.statement_role IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.vocabulary_member v
     WHERE v.release_id=r AND v.vocabulary_id='StatementRole' AND v.value=c.statement_role)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'undeclared occurrence statement role' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_evidence_role c WHERE c.release_id=r AND c.realization_id=z
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.vocabulary_member v WHERE v.release_id=r
    AND v.vocabulary_id='EvidenceRole' AND v.value=c.role)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'undeclared occurrence evidence role' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_context ctx WHERE ctx.release_id=r AND ctx.realization_id=z
   AND ctx.statement_entity_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM data.membership m JOIN sem.class_definition c
     ON c.release_id=m.release_id AND c.class_id=m.class_id
    WHERE m.release_id=r AND m.realization_id=z AND m.entity_id=ctx.statement_entity_id
     AND data.is_bound_statement(r,c.class_id))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence statement lacks SourceStatement membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR o IN SELECT * FROM data.occurrence WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z LOOP
  SELECT * INTO context FROM data.occurrence_context c WHERE c.release_id=r AND c.realization_id=z
    AND c.occurrence_id=o.occurrence_id;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion assertion WHERE assertion.release_id=r AND assertion.realization_id=z
    AND assertion.fact_id=o.fact_id) THEN
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion assertion JOIN data.source_record record_value ON
     (record_value.release_id,record_value.realization_id,record_value.record_id,record_value.interpretation_id)=
     (assertion.release_id,assertion.realization_id,assertion.record_id,assertion.interpretation_id)
     WHERE assertion.release_id=r AND assertion.realization_id=z AND assertion.fact_id=o.fact_id
      AND assertion.occurrence_id=o.occurrence_id AND record_value.source=o.source
      AND o.item=assertion.reading_id||'/'||assertion.role) OR context.occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source-reading occurrence differs from its exact record membership' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   CONTINUE;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO observation FROM kb.observation ob WHERE ob.release_id=r AND ob.observation_key=o.source;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
  IF observation.payload_definition='AgentStoredBatch' AND o.item ~ '^claims/[0-9]+$' THEN
   claim:=observation.payload->'claims'->(split_part(o.item,'/',2)::integer);
   IF claim IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence claim is outside bound source report'; END IF;
   expected_statement:=NULL;
   expected_role:=claim->>'statement_role';
   IF claim->>'statement' IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT value INTO STRICT statement FROM jsonb_array_elements(observation.payload->'statements')
     WHERE value->>'id'=claim->>'statement';
    IF statement->>'kind'<>'outside' THEN
    IF observation.source_view_id IS NOT NULL THEN
     IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.native_source_frame f WHERE f.task_id=observation.task_id
       AND f.source_view_id=observation.source_view_id AND f.unit_ref=observation.payload->>'unit_ref') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'native statement differs from its primary source frame' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
     source_rendition_key:=ops.native_source_statement_source_key(observation.task_id,statement->>'anchor');
     expected_statement:='entity:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(
      jsonb_build_array(r,z,'source-statement',source_rendition_key,
                       ops.native_source_statement_locator(observation.task_id,statement->>'anchor'))),'UTF8')),'hex');
    ELSE
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'statement requires current SourceView custody' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF (context.statement_entity_id,context.statement_role) IS DISTINCT FROM
      (expected_statement,expected_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence statement context differs from bound source claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(claim->'evidence') WITH ORDINALITY citation(value,position)
     WHERE citation.value->>'outcome'='located' AND citation.value->>'role' IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_evidence_role role
       WHERE role.release_id=r AND role.realization_id=z AND role.occurrence_id=o.occurrence_id
        AND role.role=citation.value->>'role'
        AND role.evidence_id='evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
          o.source,'claims',split_part(o.item,'/',2)::bigint,citation.position-1,citation.value)),'UTF8')),'hex'))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence citation role differs from bound source citation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF observation.payload_definition='AgentStoredBatch' AND starts_with(o.item,'entities/') THEN
   -- Match the complete declared address rather than parsing caller-supplied owner or
   -- index text. Local ids are literal, and only an actual attribute ordinal can match.
   SELECT entity_source_row.local_id,attr.value,attr.position-1
    INTO attribute_local_id,attribute,attribute_index FROM data.entity_source entity_source_row
    JOIN data.fact f ON f.release_id=r AND f.realization_id=z AND f.fact_id=o.fact_id AND f.subject_id=entity_source_row.entity_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(observation.payload->'entities') entity
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(entity->'attributes','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY attr(value,position)
    WHERE entity_source_row.release_id=r AND entity_source_row.realization_id=z AND entity_source_row.observation_id=observation.id
     AND entity->>'id'=entity_source_row.local_id
     AND o.item='entities/'||entity_source_row.local_id||'/attributes/'||(attr.position-1)::text
     AND f.property_id=attr.value->>'predicate';
   IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'attribute occurrence differs from its own source assertion' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   SELECT e.establishment INTO establishment FROM data.occurrence_establishment e
    WHERE e.release_id=r AND e.realization_id=z AND e.occurrence_id=o.occurrence_id;
   IF context.occurrence_id IS NOT NULL OR
    attribute->>'establishment' IS DISTINCT FROM establishment THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'attribute occurrence differs from its own source assertion' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(attribute->'evidence') WITH ORDINALITY citation(value,position)
     WHERE citation.value->>'outcome'='located' AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT FROM data.occurrence_evidence support
      WHERE support.release_id=r AND support.realization_id=z AND support.occurrence_id=o.occurrence_id
       AND support.evidence_id='evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
         o.source,'entities',attribute_local_id,'attributes',attribute_index,citation.position-1,citation.value)),'UTF8')),'hex'))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'attribute support differs from its own source evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF context.occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence context has no declared source claim' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR edge IN SELECT * FROM data.occurrence_evidence WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z LOOP
  SELECT * INTO citation_role FROM data.occurrence_evidence_role c
   WHERE c.release_id=r AND c.realization_id=z AND c.occurrence_id=edge.occurrence_id
    AND c.evidence_id=edge.evidence_id;
  SELECT * INTO source FROM data.evidence_source es
   WHERE es.release_id=r AND es.realization_id=z AND es.evidence_id=edge.evidence_id;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM data.occurrence occurrence WHERE occurrence.release_id=r AND occurrence.realization_id=z
   AND occurrence.occurrence_id=edge.occurrence_id;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion assertion WHERE assertion.release_id=r AND assertion.realization_id=z
    AND assertion.occurrence_id=o.occurrence_id) THEN
   IF source.evidence_id IS NOT NULL OR citation_role.occurrence_id IS NOT NULL OR
    NOT data.has_record_assertion_support(r,z,o.occurrence_id,edge.evidence_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source-reading evidence differs from sealed task field set anchor custody' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   CONTINUE;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO observation FROM kb.observation ob WHERE ob.release_id=r AND ob.observation_key=o.source;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
  IF source.observation_id IS NOT NULL AND source.observation_id<>observation.id THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence citation belongs to another source report' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  expected_role:=NULL;
  IF observation.payload_definition='AgentStoredBatch' THEN
   IF o.item LIKE 'entities/%/attributes/%' THEN
    SELECT citation.value->>'role' INTO expected_role
    FROM data.entity_source attribute_source
    JOIN data.fact f ON f.release_id=r AND f.realization_id=z AND f.fact_id=o.fact_id AND f.subject_id=attribute_source.entity_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(observation.payload->'entities') entity
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(entity->'attributes','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY attr(value,position)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(attr.value->'evidence') WITH ORDINALITY citation(value,position)
    WHERE attribute_source.release_id=r AND attribute_source.realization_id=z AND attribute_source.observation_id=observation.id
     AND entity->>'id'=attribute_source.local_id
     AND o.item='entities/'||attribute_source.local_id||'/attributes/'||(attr.position-1)::text
     AND f.property_id=attr.value->>'predicate' AND citation.value->>'outcome'='located'
     AND edge.evidence_id='evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
       o.source,'entities',attribute_source.local_id,'attributes',attr.position-1,citation.position-1,citation.value)),'UTF8')),'hex');
   ELSE
    SELECT citation.value->>'role' INTO expected_role
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(observation.payload->'claims') WITH ORDINALITY candidate(value,position)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(candidate.value->'evidence') WITH ORDINALITY citation(value,position)
    WHERE citation.value->>'outcome'='located'
     AND (o.item !~ '^claims/[0-9]+$' OR candidate.position-1=split_part(o.item,'/',2)::integer)
     AND edge.evidence_id='evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
       o.source,'claims',candidate.position-1,citation.position-1,citation.value)),'UTF8')),'hex');
   END IF;
   IF expected_role IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence citation is outside bound source claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF observation.payload_definition='SourceObservation' AND observation.kind='author_markup' THEN
   synthesis:=data.report_field(observation.payload->'payload','synthesize');
   SELECT data.report_field(citation.value,'role')->>'text' INTO expected_role
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(data.report_field(synthesis,'evidence')->'items') WITH ORDINALITY citation(value,position)
    WHERE edge.evidence_id='evidence:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
       o.source,citation.position-1,
       (data.report_field(citation.value,'start')->>'integer')::bigint,
       (data.report_field(citation.value,'end')->>'integer')::bigint)),'UTF8')),'hex');
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence citation is outside bound source synthesis' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF citation_role.role IS DISTINCT FROM expected_role THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurrence citation role differs from bound source citation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
END $fn$

DECLARE expected_policy_version text;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM sem.release WHERE release_id=r AND profile='semantic-2')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusions require composed execution capability' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN kb.observation o ON o.id=x.observation_id AND o.release_id=r
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND x.exclusion_id IS DISTINCT FROM
     'identity-exclusion:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(data.canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(r,z,o.observation_key,x.local_id)),'UTF8')),'hex'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion identity differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN kb.observation o ON o.release_id=x.release_id AND o.id=x.observation_id
  WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(o.payload->'identity_exclusions','[]')) d
   WHERE d->>'id'=x.local_id AND d->>'reason'=x.reason
     AND d->'left'->>'kind'=x.left_kind AND d->'left'->>'target'=x.left_ref
     AND d->'right'->>'kind'=x.right_kind AND d->'right'->>'target'=x.right_ref
     AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(d->'evidence') e
                WHERE e->>'outcome'='located' AND e->>'role'='primary')
  )) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion source declaration differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion WHERE release_id=r AND realization_id=z) THEN
  SELECT operation.value->>'policy_version' INTO expected_policy_version
  FROM sem.registry_row model
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(model.body,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations') operation(value)
  WHERE model.release_id=r AND model.kind='execution_model' AND operation.value->>'id'='resolve_identity';
  IF expected_policy_version IS NULL OR expected_policy_version='' OR EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z
    AND (x.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'resolve_identity'
         OR x.operation_version IS DISTINCT FROM expected_policy_version))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion operation version differs from release model' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND
   NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
     JOIN data.evidence ev USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN es.source_view_id IS NOT NULL THEN
       substring(ops.native_source_address(es.source_view_id,es.native_address) FROM 5)::jsonb END address) native
     JOIN kb.observation o ON o.id=x.observation_id AND o.release_id=r
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(o.payload->'identity_exclusions','[]')) d
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d->'evidence') e
     WHERE xe.release_id=r AND xe.realization_id=z AND xe.exclusion_id=x.exclusion_id
       AND es.observation_id=x.observation_id AND d->>'id'=x.local_id
       AND e->>'outcome'='located' AND e->>'role'='primary'
       AND (e->>'start')::bigint=(native.address->>'start')::bigint
       AND (e->>'end')::bigint=(native.address->>'end')::bigint
       AND ev.locator::jsonb=jsonb_build_object('locator',e->'locator','start',(e->>'start')::bigint,
         'end',(e->>'end')::bigint,'role',e->'role')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion lacks located primary custody' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(x.left_kind,x.left_ref,x.left_entity_id),(x.right_kind,x.right_ref,x.right_entity_id)) ep(kind,ref,entity)
  WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND NOT (
   (ep.kind='local' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.entity_source src WHERE src.release_id=r AND src.realization_id=z
       AND src.observation_id=x.observation_id AND src.local_id=ep.ref AND src.entity_id=ep.entity)) OR
   (ep.kind='known' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.entity_input i WHERE i.release_id=r AND i.realization_id=z
       AND i.input_entity_id=ep.ref AND i.entity_id=ep.entity)) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion prior
     JOIN data.entity_input l ON l.release_id=r AND l.realization_id=z AND l.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id
       AND l.input_entity_id=prior.left_entity_id AND l.entity_id=x.left_entity_id
     JOIN data.entity_input rr ON rr.release_id=r AND rr.realization_id=z AND rr.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id
       AND rr.input_entity_id=prior.right_entity_id AND rr.entity_id=x.right_entity_id
     WHERE prior.release_id=r AND prior.observation_id=x.observation_id AND prior.local_id=x.local_id)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion endpoint assignment differs' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion x WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND NOT (
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.run job JOIN ops.input_cut cut ON cut.run_id=job.id AND cut.final
     JOIN ops.cut_task ct ON ct.cut_id=cut.id JOIN kb.observation o ON o.task_id=ct.origin_task_id
     WHERE job.release_id=r AND job.result_realization_id=z AND o.id=x.observation_id) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion prior
     JOIN data.entity_input l ON l.release_id=r AND l.realization_id=z AND l.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id AND l.input_entity_id=prior.left_entity_id AND l.entity_id=x.left_entity_id
     JOIN data.entity_input rr ON rr.release_id=r AND rr.realization_id=z AND rr.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id AND rr.input_entity_id=prior.right_entity_id AND rr.entity_id=x.right_entity_id
     WHERE prior.release_id=r AND prior.observation_id=x.observation_id AND prior.local_id=x.local_id)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion source outside effective cut or input binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH expected AS (
   SELECT x.exclusion_id,(e->>'start')::bigint start_offset,(e->>'end')::bigint end_offset,e->>'role' role,e->>'locator' locator,count(*) n
   FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN kb.observation o ON o.release_id=r AND o.id=x.observation_id
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(o.payload->'identity_exclusions','[]')) d
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d->'evidence') e
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND d->>'id'=x.local_id AND e->>'outcome'='located'
   GROUP BY x.exclusion_id,e->>'start',e->>'end',e->>'role',e->>'locator'
 ), actual AS (
   SELECT x.exclusion_id,(native.address->>'start')::bigint start_offset,
     (native.address->>'end')::bigint end_offset,
     ev.locator::jsonb->>'role' role,ev.locator::jsonb->>'locator' locator,count(*) n
   FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe USING(release_id,realization_id,exclusion_id)
   JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   JOIN data.evidence ev USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN es.source_view_id IS NOT NULL THEN
     substring(ops.native_source_address(es.source_view_id,es.native_address) FROM 5)::jsonb END address) native
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND es.observation_id=x.observation_id
   GROUP BY x.exclusion_id,(native.address->>'start')::bigint,
     (native.address->>'end')::bigint,ev.locator::jsonb->>'role',ev.locator::jsonb->>'locator'
 ) SELECT FROM ((SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)
   UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)) mismatch)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion evidence differs from source citations' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe JOIN data.identity_exclusion x USING(release_id,realization_id,exclusion_id)
   LEFT JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   WHERE xe.release_id=r AND xe.realization_id=z AND es.observation_id IS DISTINCT FROM x.observation_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion evidence outside source observation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

     WHERE job.release_id=r AND job.result_realization_id=z AND o.id=x.observation_id) OR
   EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion prior
     JOIN data.entity_input l ON l.release_id=r AND l.realization_id=z AND l.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id AND l.input_entity_id=prior.left_entity_id AND l.entity_id=x.left_entity_id
     JOIN data.entity_input rr ON rr.release_id=r AND rr.realization_id=z AND rr.input_realization_id=prior.realization_id AND rr.input_entity_id=prior.right_entity_id AND rr.entity_id=x.right_entity_id
     WHERE prior.release_id=r AND prior.observation_id=x.observation_id AND prior.local_id=x.local_id)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion source outside effective cut or input binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH expected AS (
   SELECT x.exclusion_id,(e->>'start')::bigint start_offset,(e->>'end')::bigint end_offset,e->>'role' role,e->>'locator' locator,count(*) n
   FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN kb.observation o ON o.release_id=r AND o.id=x.observation_id
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(o.payload->'identity_exclusions','[]')) d
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d->'evidence') e
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND d->>'id'=x.local_id AND e->>'outcome'='located'
   GROUP BY x.exclusion_id,e->>'start',e->>'end',e->>'role',e->>'locator'
 ), actual AS (
   SELECT x.exclusion_id,(native.address->>'start')::bigint start_offset,
     (native.address->>'end')::bigint end_offset,
     ev.locator::jsonb->>'role' role,ev.locator::jsonb->>'locator' locator,count(*) n
   FROM data.identity_exclusion x JOIN data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe USING(release_id,realization_id,exclusion_id)
   JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   JOIN data.evidence ev USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN es.source_view_id IS NOT NULL THEN
     substring(ops.native_source_address(es.source_view_id,es.native_address) FROM 5)::jsonb END address) native
   WHERE x.release_id=r AND x.realization_id=z AND es.observation_id=x.observation_id
   GROUP BY x.exclusion_id,(native.address->>'start')::bigint,
     (native.address->>'end')::bigint,ev.locator::jsonb->>'role',ev.locator::jsonb->>'locator'
 ) SELECT FROM ((SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)
   UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)) mismatch)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion evidence differs from source citations' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.identity_exclusion_evidence xe JOIN data.identity_exclusion x USING(release_id,realization_id,exclusion_id)
   LEFT JOIN data.evidence_source es USING(release_id,realization_id,evidence_id)
   WHERE xe.release_id=r AND xe.realization_id=z AND es.observation_id IS DISTINCT FROM x.observation_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'identity exclusion evidence outside source observation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $fn$

DECLARE job ops.task; run ops.run; parameters jsonb; retained_product jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT run FROM ops.run WHERE id=p_run FOR SHARE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT job FROM ops.task WHERE id=p_task AND run_id=p_run;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_operation(run.release_id,'publish_source_view');
 IF job.status<>'reused' OR job.reused_task_id IS NULL OR NOT ops.valid_reuse(job)
 OR run.sealed OR run.status NOT IN ('created','running') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'source view reuse is not bound to successful source origin' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT params INTO STRICT parameters FROM ops.method_config WHERE id=job.method_config_id;
 IF NULLIF(parameters->'native_product','null'::jsonb) IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(parameters->'integrated_product','null'::jsonb) IS NOT NULL THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'source view reuse requires one declared retained product' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 retained_product:=COALESCE(NULLIF(parameters->'integrated_product','null'::jsonb),
                            NULLIF(parameters->'native_product','null'::jsonb));
 INSERT INTO ops.run_source_view(run_id,source_view_id,position)
 SELECT p_run,v.id,s.position FROM ops.task origin
 JOIN ops.run origin_run ON origin_run.id=origin.run_id
 JOIN ops.run_source_view s ON s.run_id=origin.run_id
 JOIN kb.source_view v ON v.id=s.source_view_id
 JOIN kb.document d ON d.id=v.document_id AND d.id=job.unit_id
 JOIN ops.source_build own ON own.task_id=origin.id AND own.artifact_digest=d.content_hash
 JOIN ops.source_build native_build ON native_build.task_id=v.native_task_id AND native_build.artifact_digest=d.content_hash
 JOIN ops.task native_task ON native_task.id=v.native_task_id
 JOIN ops.run native_run ON native_run.id=native_task.run_id
 JOIN ops.pdf_selected_product native ON native.task_id=v.native_task_id
  AND native.product_key=v.native_product_key AND native.content_digest=v.native_content_digest
 WHERE origin.id=job.reused_task_id AND job.unit_type='document'
 AND origin_run.project_id=run.project_id AND origin_run.release_id=run.release_id
 AND v.release_id=run.release_id AND d.project_id=run.project_id AND native_run.project_id=run.project_id
 -- Producers may declare a retained input and publish their own organized output.
 -- Direct retention also admits the exact declared pin, without JSON numeric casts.
 AND (v.native_task_id=origin.id
  OR retained_product=jsonb_build_object('task_id',native.task_id,'product_key',native.product_key,'content_digest',native.content_digest))
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
END

DECLARE cut ops.input_cut; job ops.run;
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation publication requires SERIALIZABLE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT cut FROM ops.input_cut WHERE id=p_cut;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT job FROM ops.run WHERE id=cut.run_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT cut.final OR NOT job.sealed OR job.status NOT IN ('consolidating','finished') OR
    job.result_realization_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_output THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation run fence changed'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.realization WHERE realization_id=p_output AND release_id=job.release_id AND project_id=job.project_id AND realization_id<>job.input_realization_id AND state='active') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'output realization differs from bound run'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.batch WHERE realization_id=p_output AND release_id=job.release_id
  AND batch_id=p_batch) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation result has no admitted receipt'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence o WHERE o.release_id=job.release_id AND o.realization_id=p_output
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_evidence oe JOIN data.evidence_source es
    ON (es.release_id,es.realization_id,es.evidence_id)=(oe.release_id,oe.realization_id,oe.evidence_id)
    JOIN kb.observation observation ON observation.id=es.observation_id
    JOIN ops.cut_task ct ON ct.origin_task_id=observation.task_id AND ct.cut_id=p_cut
    WHERE (oe.release_id,oe.realization_id,oe.occurrence_id)=(o.release_id,o.realization_id,o.occurrence_id)
      AND (es.span_id IS NOT NULL OR (es.source_view_id IS NOT NULL AND es.native_address IS NOT NULL AND ops.native_source_address(es.source_view_id,es.native_address)=es.native_address)))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence_evidence oe
   JOIN data.record_assertion_support support ON
    (support.release_id,support.realization_id,support.occurrence_id,support.evidence_id)=
    (oe.release_id,oe.realization_id,oe.occurrence_id,oe.evidence_id)
   JOIN ops.cut_task selected ON selected.cut_id=p_cut AND selected.origin_task_id=support.origin_task_id
   WHERE (oe.release_id,oe.realization_id,oe.occurrence_id)=(o.release_id,o.realization_id,o.occurrence_id)
    AND data.has_record_assertion_support(job.release_id,p_output,o.occurrence_id,oe.evidence_id))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'source occurrence has no located evidence in sealed cut'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.occurrence o JOIN data.occurrence_evidence oe
   ON (oe.release_id,oe.realization_id,oe.occurrence_id)=(o.release_id,o.realization_id,o.occurrence_id)
   JOIN data.evidence_source es ON (es.release_id,es.realization_id,es.evidence_id)=
    (oe.release_id,oe.realization_id,oe.evidence_id)
   JOIN kb.observation observation ON observation.id=es.observation_id
   WHERE o.release_id=job.release_id AND o.realization_id=p_output AND
   NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.cut_task ct WHERE ct.cut_id=p_cut AND ct.origin_task_id=observation.task_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'evaluation evidence is outside sealed observation cut'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM data.record_assertion_support support
  WHERE support.release_id=job.release_id AND support.realization_id=p_output
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM ops.cut_task selected
    WHERE selected.cut_id=p_cut AND selected.origin_task_id=support.origin_task_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'reading evidence is outside sealed source cut'; END IF;
 UPDATE ops.run SET result_realization_id=p_output,status='finished' WHERE id=job.id;
END
